_en.title: Raspberry Cream Cheese Croissant (Nadiya's Quick Recipes, Netflix)
_en.intro:
20231218, #breakfastdiary 925, 0°C/mostly clear, 20 min/workout (T) 
Croissants filled with fresh(?) frozen raspberries mixed with ricotta and baked until wonderfully crisp 🥐
Raspberries are a not-too-distant cousin of our native wild raspberries. This filling turned out less sweet than I expected — I almost wondered if I should've added more sugar — but apparently raspberries are naturally more tart than sweet to begin with. It's a tart-more-than-sweet kind of flavor. 
Mix 150g ricotta cheese (one whole tub), 1 sugar, a splash of vanilla extract, and a cup of raspberries until evenly combined. The color is genuinely gorgeous. Add 1T all-purpose flour and half an egg, mix a bit more, and the filling is done. 
Split store-bought croissants in half, press them into a muffin tin, and fill with the prepared filling. Bake for 10 minutes in a 180°C oven.

_en.title: Gupo Soy Sauce Noodles
_en.intro:
20231217, #breakfastdiary 924, -9°C/mostly clear, 20 min/workout (Y) 
Gupo noodles originated in Busan's Gupo Market, and after a court ruled that no single business could monopolize a name that's essentially a local specialty, almost every noodle maker in Busan started using the 'Gupo noodles' name. Not quite the same story, but it reminds me a bit of how 'Kimbap Heaven' became a generic name too. 
Mix 4 soy sauce, 2 sesame oil, 2 sugar, and 0.5 minced garlic well to make a dressing. 
Boil the noodles and rinse thoroughly in cold water. Plate the noodles, top with an egg yolk, chopped chives, sesame seeds, and drizzle with the dressing.

_en.title: Hot Dog
_en.intro:
20231216, #breakfastdiary 923, -5°C/windy
We call this affliction boredom, the feeling that life is meaningless, the sense that an abundant yet joyless life is slipping through your fingers like sand, the bewildered feeling of not knowing where to go or what to do. The French gave it a name, but we never did. We only got our own name for it fairly recently. We call this affliction 'neurosis.'
@longblack.co Why do I keep falling back into this listlessness
When I feel listless, I don't overthink it — I just do something. Doing it is how you figure it out. 
A pre-pandemic, one-dollar hot dog from a food truck near St. Lawrence Avenue in the Bronx, New York 
Melt a knob of butter in a pan and warm the bun on both sides. 
(Casually, as if it's nothing) Top the bun with ketchup, mustard, and sriracha, then add chopped tomato and onion.

title: 무조림을곁들인온메밀 온메밀
intro:
20231214, #조식다이어리 922, 7도/이슬비, 21분/운동(Y) 
오늘 아침 싸늘할 것을 내다보고 만든 따뜻한 국물 조식 #무조림을곁들인온메밀 
예상은 어긋났으나 👍
냄비에 한가득 물 붓고 다시마, 표고버섯 넣고 끓인다. 물이 끓으면 불 끄고 다시마와 버섯 건져내고 가쓰오부시를 넣는다. 잠시 고요히 뒀다가 가쓰오부시 건져낸다. (시간이 있어서 만든 다시국물) 
냄비에 다시국물 850ml 가량 붓고 간장, 쯔유, 올리고당 각 1T 넣고 졸여서 무를 (대략 20분 길이 요가 프로그램 하나정도 하고 나면 완성된다) 졸인다. 
무를 졸인 다시국물에 육수 200ml 붓고 간장 1, 올리고당 1 넣고 따뜻하게 끓인다. 
메밀면 삶아서 찬물에 헹구고 버섯, 무와 함께 담고 방금 전에 만든 국물을 붓는다. 
@sogumgooi 님 레시피 입니다.

_en.title: Warm Buckwheat Noodles with Braised Radish
_en.intro:
20231214, #breakfastdiary 922, 7°C/drizzle, 21 min/workout (Y) 
A warm, brothy breakfast I made expecting a chilly morning — #warmbuckwheatnoodleswithbraisedradish 
Turns out I was wrong about the weather 👍
Fill a pot with plenty of water and add kelp and shiitake mushrooms, then bring to a boil. Once it boils, turn off the heat, remove the kelp and mushrooms, and add bonito flakes. Let it sit quietly for a bit, then strain out the bonito flakes. (A dashi broth made because I had the time for it) 
Pour about 850ml of the dashi into a pot, add 1T each of soy sauce, tsuyu, and oligo syrup, and braise the radish down (it's ready after about the length of a 20-minute yoga session). 
Pour 200ml of stock into the dashi used for braising the radish, add 1 soy sauce and 1 oligo syrup, and bring to a gentle simmer. 
Boil the buckwheat noodles, rinse in cold water, plate with the mushrooms and radish, and pour over the broth you just made. 
Recipe from @sogumgooi.

title: 표고버섯 표고버섯파스타 파스타
intro:
20231213, #조식다이어리 921, 1도/대체로 맑음
#표고버섯 이 더 시들기 전에 그래서 오로지 표고버섯에만 집중한 #표고버섯파스타
표고버섯 5개, 줄기를 떼고 갓을 키친타월로 잘 닦는다. 2개는 큼지막하게 썰고 3개는 잘게 다진다. 
달군 팬에 올리브 오일 흠뻑 두르고 버섯 넣고 볶는다. 버섯이 오일을 충분히 머금고 준비됐다 싶으면 다진 마늘, 페페론치노(씨 제거 후)도 넣는다. 
냄비에 물이 끓으면 파스타를 넣고 2~3분 후 건져서 준비한 버섯이 있는 팬에 넣고 면수 붓고 끓인다. 면수가 졸아들 때쯤 소금 넣고 만테까레, 접시에 담는다. 
*유튜브 준스 비스트로 레시피를 참고했습니다.

_en.title: Shiitake Mushroom Pasta
_en.intro:
20231213, #breakfastdiary 921, 1°C/mostly clear
Before my #shiitakemushrooms wilt any further, a #shiitakemushroompasta built entirely around them
Trim the stems off 5 shiitake mushrooms and wipe the caps clean with a paper towel. Cut 2 into big chunks and finely chop the other 3. 
Heat a generous amount of olive oil in a pan and cook the mushrooms. Once they've soaked up enough oil and look ready, add minced garlic and peperoncino (seeds removed). 
When the pot of water boils, add the pasta, cook for 2-3 minutes, then drain and add it to the pan with the mushrooms along with some pasta water, and simmer. Once the pasta water has reduced, add salt, mantecare it together, and plate. 
*Reference recipe from the YouTube channel Jun's Bistro.

title: 베러미트 쿠스쿠스샐러드 식물성대체육

_en.title: Couscous Salad with Plant-Based Meat
_en.intro:
20231212, #breakfastdiary 920, 4°C/cloudy, 21 min/workout (L)
To #BetterMeat — it's debatable, sure, but they say it's 100% plant-based with no sodium nitrite or animal fat, so surely it's earned a seat at the table alongside the other vegetables in this salad? 🤔
Soak 100g couscous in 100g water. 
Cut up the Better Meat and add it along with tomato, apple, onion, olives, and cucumber, then mix in olive oil, salt, salt, pepper, pepper, and lemon juice, and toss well. 
Plate it and top with a few mint leaves. 
Reference recipe from @leplat_pmj.

title: 길거리토스트 시애틀핫도그 핫도그
intro:
20231211, #조식다이어리 919, 9도/흐림, 21분/운동(Y)
#길거리토스트 가 한국의 대표적인 먹을거리로 뉴욕타임즈에 실린 게 벌써 몇 해 전이다. 마찬가지로 (최근이라고 하기엔 좀 지난 얘기지만) 한국식 핫도그 역시 해외에서 큰 인기다. 그 인기의 비결은 다양한 재료와 소스(의 조합)에 있다고 한다. 
사실 미국식 핫도그도 지역별로 다양한 재료와 소스가 사용된다. 물론 해당 지역에서도 개인의 취향에 따라 다양한 조합의 핫도그가 나올 수 있다.
시애틀식 핫도그는 특이하게 크림 치즈가 들어가는데 여기저기 찾아보고 챗gpt에게도 물어봤지만 그 이유를 찾진 못했다. 
소금, 후추 넣고 양파 흠뻑 볶아서(보통 캐러멜라이즈드 양파라고 한다) 준비한다. 
소시지는 세로로 길게 반으로 갈라 에프에 5분 굽는다. 
그동안 핫도그 번을 반으로 갈라 버터 두른 팬에 굽는다. (이런 또 탔다) 
번에 크림 치즈 듬뿍 바르고 준비된 소시지, 흠뻑 볶은 양파, 사워크라우트 올리고 스리라차 소스 좌악~ 
보기 보단 맛도리, 본격 시애틀식 핫도그

_en.title: Seattle-Style Hot Dog (Street Toast Style)
_en.intro:
20231211, #breakfastdiary 919, 9°C/cloudy, 21 min/workout (Y)
It's already been a few years since #streettoast made it into the New York Times as a signature Korean street food. In the same vein (though this news is a bit old too), Korean-style hot dogs have become quite popular abroad as well. The secret to that popularity is said to lie in the sheer variety of ingredients and sauces used. 
Actually, American hot dogs vary a lot by region too, each with its own signature ingredients and sauces. And of course, within any one region, personal taste produces all kinds of combinations. 
Seattle-style hot dogs oddly include cream cheese, and even after searching around and asking ChatGPT, I never did find out why. 
Sauté onion thoroughly with salt and pepper (usually called caramelized onion) and set aside. 
Split the sausage lengthwise and air-fry for 5 minutes. 
Meanwhile, split the hot dog bun in half and toast in a buttered pan. (Oh no, burnt it again) 
Spread the bun generously with cream cheese, then top with the sausage, the well-sautéed onion, sauerkraut, and a good squeeze of sriracha~ 
Better than it looks — a proper Seattle-style hot dog

title: 콩고기?’ 대체육 비욘드미트
intro:
20231210, #조식다이어리 918, 5도/흐림, 21분/운동(U)
‘대체육? 아, 그거? #콩고기?’ 
#대체육 이라고 하면 대개 이런 반응이었다. 고기의 텍스처와 향을 흉내냈지반 뭔가 기대에는 한참 미치지 못했는데 최근 몇 년간 이 분야에서도 많은 발전이 있었다. 
이미 수 년 전부터 해외에선 #비욘드미트 #임파서블푸드 가 KFC나 버거킹에 대체육을 공급하고 있고 국내에서도 신세계푸드나 풀무원 같은 기업들이 대체육은 물론 대체육을 사용하는 음식점까지 시장을 확대해 나가고 있다. 
신세계푸드 #런천김치덮밥 전자렌지에 2분 30초 데운다. 덮밥에 (런천 한 조각이 들어 있지만) #식물성런천 한 조각 잘라 팬에 구워 얹는다. 
물론 이대로 먹어도 맛있지만 다진 실파, 런천 한 조각 베어 물고 나서 빼먹은 참기름을 더한다.

_en.title: 'Bean Meat?' — Alternative Meat
_en.intro:
20231210, #breakfastdiary 918, 5°C/cloudy, 21 min/workout (U)
'Alternative meat? Oh, that? #beanmeat?' 
That used to be the typical reaction to #alternativemeat. It mimicked the texture and aroma of real meat, but fell well short of expectations — though the category has come a long way in just the past few years. 
Overseas, #BeyondMeat and #ImpossibleFoods have already been supplying alternative meat to chains like KFC and Burger King for years, and domestically, companies like Shinsegae Food and Pulmuone are expanding the market too — not just the alternative meat itself, but restaurants built around it. 
Microwave Shinsegae Food's #luncheonkimchiricebowl for 2 minutes 30 seconds. Even though it already comes with a slice of luncheon meat, I slice up a piece of #plantbasedluncheonmeat, pan-fry it, and add it on top anyway. 
Of course it's tasty just like that, but after a bite with the chopped chives and luncheon meat, I remember the sesame oil I forgot to add, and stir that in too.

20231209, #breakfastdiary 917, 10°C/mostly cloudy
I zoned out for just a moment and burned it. At least it was the dumplings and not my peace of mind, so I'll call that a win.

title: 중국식토마토스크램블에그 토마토 스크램블
intro:
20231208, #조식다이어리 916, 9도/대체로 맑음, 21분/운동(Y)
토마토 케첩과 옥수수 전분을 넣어 좀 더 상큼하고 (보기에도) 발랄하고 게다가 크리미한 본격 #중국식토마토스크램블에그
실파, 양파, 토마토는 잘게 썰고, 계란 2개 풀고 소금, 후추 더해서 준비한다. 
달군 팬에 오일 두르고 다진 양파가 투명해질 때까지 볶는다. 
다진 방울토마토 넣고 볶다가 토마토 케첩 1T, 설탕1t, 물 1T 그리고 물 2T에 옥수수 전분 1t 넣고 잘 섞은 뒤에 붓고 조금 더 끓인 뒤 그릇에 덜어둔다. 
팬에 오일 두르고 소금, 후추 넣고 풀어둔 계란 넣고 젓다가 계란이 익을까 말까를 망설이는 순간이 되면 불을 끄고 준비해 둔 토마토를 붓고 고루 섞는다. 다진 실파로 마무리~
아, 이건 밥 위에 얹어서 덮밥처럼 먹는 겁니다. 
유튜브 #TasteofAsianfood , KP Kwan의 레시피 입니다.

_en.title: Chinese-Style Tomato Scrambled Eggs
_en.intro:
20231208, #breakfastdiary 916, 9°C/mostly clear, 21 min/workout (Y)
With ketchup and corn starch added for extra tang, a brighter look, and a creamy finish — a proper #Chinesestyletomatoscrambledeggs
Finely chop chives, onion, and tomato, and prep 2 beaten eggs with salt and pepper. 
Heat oil in a pan and sauté the chopped onion until translucent. 
Add the chopped cherry tomatoes and sauté, then stir in 1T ketchup, 1t sugar, 1T water, plus a mixture of 2T water with 1t corn starch, pour it in, simmer a bit longer, and set aside in a bowl. 
Heat oil in a pan, add salt and pepper to the beaten eggs, pour them in, and stir. Right at the moment you're unsure whether the eggs are cooked or not, turn off the heat, pour in the tomato mixture, and mix evenly. Finish with the chopped chives~
Oh, and this is meant to be eaten over rice, like a rice bowl. 
Recipe from KP Kwan's YouTube channel, #TasteofAsianFood. 
Just adding this one thing changes tomato scrambled eggs completely — #Chinesestyletomatoscrambledeggs

title: 팬케이크
intro:
20231207, #조식다이어리 915, 1도/맑음
시중에 파는 핫케이크 믹스나 오늘 먹은 제품처럼 간편하게 물이나 우유만 붓고 흔들면 반죽이 완성되는 제품을 사용하더라도 팬케이크는 (제대로 만들려면) 세심한 불조절과 인고의 시간이 필요한 꽤 까다로운 조식이다.
마치 잔잔한 호수에 낚시대를 던지고 멍하니 앉아 있는데 누군가 곁을 지나며 ‘무얼 낚고 있소’하고 묻는 상황에서 ‘허허, 세월을 낚고 있소’라는 대답 대신에 ‘허허허, 팬케이크를 굽고 있소’라고 답해도 전혀 어색하지 않은 그런 느낌이랄까? 팬에 반죽 붓고 멍때리다가 든 생각이다. 
은근한 불에 오일 두르고 키친타월로 팬을 코팅한다. 5분 정도 그대로 둔다. 
시판 팬케이크 믹스에 물 붓고 쒜낏, 한 국자 떠서 팬 위에 붓고 인내심을 갖고 기다린다. 인내심이 한계에 다다를 무렵 뒤집고 다시 인고의 시간을 기다린다. 이렇게 하면 비로소 한 장 완성된다. 
버터 한 덩어리 올리고 촉촉함과 달콤함을 더해줄 메이플 시럽 듬뿍~
raw:
20231207, #조식다이어리 915, 1도/맑음

시중에 파는 핫케이크 믹스나 오늘 먹은 제품처럼 간편하게 물이나 우유만 붓고 흔들면 반죽이 완성되는 제품을 사용하더라도 팬케이크는 (제대로 만들려면) 세심한 불조절과 인고의 시간이 필요한 꽤 까다로운 조식이다.
마치 잔잔한 호수에 낚시대를 던지고 멍하니 앉아 있는데 누군가 곁을 지나며 ‘무얼 낚고 있소’하고 묻는 상황에서 ‘허허, 세월을 낚고 있소’라는 대답 대신에 ‘허허허, 팬케이크를 굽고 있소’라고 답해도 전혀 어색하지 않은 그런 느낌이랄까? 팬에 반죽 붓고 멍때리다가 든 생각이다. 

#팬케이크

은근한 불에 오일 두르고 키친타월로 팬을 코팅한다. 5분 정도 그대로 둔다. 
시판 팬케이크 믹스에 물 붓고 쒜낏, 한 국자 떠서 팬 위에 붓고 인내심을 갖고 기다린다. 인내심이 한계에 다다를 무렵 뒤집고 다시 인고의 시간을 기다린다. 이렇게 하면 비로소 한 장 완성된다. 
버터 한 덩어리 올리고 촉촉함과 달콤함을 더해줄 메이플 시럽 듬뿍~

#조식 #레시피 #미라클모닝 #팬케이크

_en.title: Pancakes
_en.intro:
20231207, #breakfastdiary 915, 1°C/clear
Even with a store-bought pancake mix, or a product like the one I had today where you just add water or milk and shake to make the batter, pancakes are (if you want to do it right) actually a surprisingly demanding breakfast that calls for careful heat control and a fair bit of patience.
It's a bit like casting a line into a still lake and sitting there blankly, and when someone passing by asks 'what are you fishing for,' instead of answering 'oh, just fishing for time,' you could just as naturally say 'oh, just cooking pancakes' — that kind of feeling. That's what crossed my mind while pouring batter into the pan and zoning out. 
Over gentle heat, add oil and coat the pan with a paper towel. Leave it be for about 5 minutes. 
Pour water into the store-bought pancake mix, shake it up, ladle a scoop onto the pan, and wait patiently. Just as your patience is about to run out, flip it and wait through another stretch of patience. That's how you finally get one finished pancake. 
Top with a knob of butter and a generous pour of maple syrup for extra moistness and sweetness~

_en.title: Fish Cake Soup (Eomuk-tang)
_en.intro:
20231206, #breakfastdiary 914, 4°C/cloudy, 21min/workout(L) 
Pour 700ml of water into a pot and add the powdered soup packet that comes with the store-bought fish cakes. The broth is already worldly-perfect on its own, but for a little extra depth I add a big chunk of radish and some shiitake mushrooms and (🎱🎱) let it simmer. (The water made it a bit bland, so I added 2T of tsuyu.) 
Skewer the fish cakes on sticks, drop them into the pot, and blanch for about 5 minutes. 
In a bowl, arrange crown daisy greens, shiitake mushrooms, a boiled egg, and the fish cakes, then pour in the broth.

title: 쑥갓두부샐러드 김대석셰프 두부
intro:
20231205, #조식다이어리 913, 1도/대체로 흐림, 21분/운동(Y) 
같은 재료도 무치면 사이드 메뉴가 되고, 쌓아 올리면 메인 메뉴가 된다는 시실을 다시 깨달았다. 
재료: 쑥갓 270g, (데칠 때 천일염 1t사용), 두부 한 모, 다진마늘 1/t, 소금 1/3t, 간장 1/2t, 참기름 1/2, 검은깨 1T, 땅콩 10알
(재료는 유튜브 #김대석셰프 레시피 입니다.) 
끓는 물에 소금 넣고 3cm 크기로 자른 쑥갓을 데친다. 찬물에 헹구고 물기를 짠다. 
두부는 쑥갓 데친 물에 1분 가량 데친다. 
접시에 쑥갓, 두부 으깨서 올리고 드레싱, 검은깨, 다진 땅콩 올린다. 살살 비벼서 먹는다. 
(무치지 않는다면 마늘은 빼도 좋을 것 같다.)

_en.title: Crown Daisy and Tofu Salad
_en.intro:
20231205, #breakfastdiary 913, 1°C/mostly cloudy, 21min/workout(Y) 
I was reminded again that the same ingredients become a side dish when tossed, and a main dish when stacked up. 
Ingredients: 270g crown daisy greens (1t sea salt for blanching), 1 block tofu, 1/3t minced garlic, 1/3t salt, 1/2t soy sauce, 1/2 sesame oil, 1T black sesame seeds, 10 peanuts
(Ingredients from a YouTube recipe by #chefkimdaeseok.) 
Add salt to boiling water and blanch crown daisy greens cut into 3cm pieces. Rinse in cold water and squeeze out the moisture. 
Blanch the tofu in the same water used for the greens for about 1 minute. 
On a plate, arrange the crown daisy greens and mash the tofu on top, then add the dressing, black sesame seeds, and chopped peanuts. Toss gently and enjoy. 
(If you're not tossing it, you could probably skip the garlic.)

title: 카이찌여우 더쿡 태국오믈렛
intro:
20231204, #조식다이어리 912, -5도/맑음, 21분/운동(U) 
태국식 오믈렛, #카이찌여우
#더쿡 에 따르면 오믈렛 조리의 격렬함을 나타내는 척도가 있다면 가장 왼쪽에 프랑스식 오믈렛이 조금 더 오른쪽에 미국식 오믈렛이 그리고 오른쪽 끝에 태국식 오믈렛, 카이찌여우가 있을 것이라고, 
아무튼 기름에 튀긴 음식이니 맛이 없을리가 없겠지만 그 가운데서도 특히 가장자리, 여러 겹의 날아갈 듯 폭신하고 동시에 바삭한 텍스처가 #jmt
우선 스리라차 소스2T, 피시소스1/2t, 올리고당1t, 라임주스1T 섞어서 드레싱을 만든다. 
계란 2개, 피시소스1/2t 넣고 잘 섞는다. (잘 섞어야 한다.) 웍에 오일을 충분히 넣고 살짝 연기가 날 때까지 달군 후 풀어둔 계란을 붓는다. 
약 30초 후에 (바닥면이 익은 걸 살짝 확인하고,) 기름이 튀지 않도록 조심해서 뒤집는다. 마찬가지로 약 30초 후, 바닥면을 확인하고 팬 위에서 오일을 살짝 털어내고 신속하게 밥 위에 덮는다. 
준비한 스리라차 드레싱 붓고 (고수가 있으면 좋겠지만 없으므로,) 실파 다져서 올린다.

_en.title: Thai Omelette (Kai Jeow)
_en.intro:
20231204, #breakfastdiary 912, -5°C/clear, 21min/workout(U) 
A Thai-style omelette, #kaijeow
According to #thecook, if there's a scale for how intense omelette cooking gets, French omelettes sit at the far left, American omelettes a bit further right, and all the way at the right end is the Thai omelette, kai jeow. 
Anyway, anything deep-fried can hardly taste bad, but what really gets me is the edges — those airy, ready-to-fly-away layers that are somehow crispy at the same time. #soyummy
First, mix 2T sriracha sauce, 1/2t fish sauce, 1t oligo syrup, and 1T lime juice to make the dressing. 
Beat 2 eggs with 1/2t fish sauce until well combined. (Really mix it well.) Pour plenty of oil into a wok, heat until it just starts to smoke, then pour in the beaten eggs. 
After about 30 seconds — once you've checked the bottom has set — carefully flip it so the oil doesn't splatter. Another 30 seconds later, check the bottom again, shake off a little oil over the pan, and quickly flip it onto the rice. 
Pour over the sriracha dressing (cilantro would be great here, but I didn't have any) and top with chopped scallions.

_en.title: Cabbage Steak
_en.intro:
20231203, #breakfastdiary 911, 4°C/clear
Every time I opened the fridge, that awkward leftover bit of cabbage had been bugging me for over a week, so I finally just used it up. 
Ingredients: cabbage, soy dressing (2 soy sauce, 2 cooking wine, 1 sugar, 0.5 garlic, 1/2 cup water), scallions (optional) 
Heat oil in a pan and lay the cabbage in. Sear both sides once, drizzle with the soy dressing, and sear both sides again. Once the cabbage turns tender, move it to a plate, drizzle with the remaining dressing, and top with scallions. 
A really simple #cabbagesteak

title: 그럴수록요리 감자 안초비
intro:
20231201, #조식다이어리 909, -7도/맑음, 21분/운동(Y) 
#그럴수록요리 라는 에세이의 호두와 쑥삿을 곁들인 안초비 감자샐러드 레시피 인데 양과 순서를 조금 달리했다. 레시피에는 감자 으깬 다음 양파, 쑥갓을 넣으라고 하는데 버터, 마요네즈, 요거트 같은 액체류를 먼저 넣는 것이 반죽할 때 수월하다. 생각보다 전완근을 많이 써야 하는 요리, 💪
재료: 감자 3개, 양파 반 개, 쑥갓 2줄기, 버터 1T, 안초비 2마리, 호두 반 줌, 마요네즈 2T, 요거트 1T, 기타 소금, 후추
냄비에 물 붓고 껍질채 감자를 삶아서 뜨거울 때 껍질을 벗기고 으깬다. 
안초비, 마요네즈, 요거트를 넣고 골고루 섞은 다음 양파, 쑥갓, 호두를 넣고 안초비를 넣은 다음 소금은 간을 봐가며 더하는 게 좋다. 후추와 안초비 (빠졌던) 오일도 조금 넣으면 풍미가 좋다. 
접시에 소복하게 담고 실파, 호두 한 조각

#그럴수록요리 라는 에세이의 호두와 쑥삿을 곁들인 안초비 감자샐러드 레시피 인데 양과 순서를 조금 달리했다. 레시피에는 감자 으깬 다음 양파, 쑥갓을 넣으라고 하는데 버터, 마요네즈, 요거트 같은 액체류를 먼저 넣는 것이 반죽할 때 수월하다. 생각보다 전완근을 많이 써야 하는 요리, 💪

재료: 감자 3개, 양파 반 개, 쑥갓 2줄기, 버터 1T, 안초비 2마리, 호두 반 줌, 마요네즈 2T, 요거트 1T, 기타 소금, 후추

냄비에 물 붓고 껍질채 감자를 삶아서 뜨거울 때 껍질을 벗기고 으깬다. 
안초비, 마요네즈, 요거트를 넣고 골고루 섞은 다음 양파, 쑥갓, 호두를 넣고 안초비를 넣은 다음 소금은 간을 봐가며 더하는 게 좋다. 후추와 안초비 (빠졌던) 오일도 조금 넣으면 풍미가 좋다. 
접시에 소복하게 담고 실파, 호두 한 조각 

#조식 #레시피 #미라클모닝 #샐러드 #감자 #안초비

_en.title: Anchovy Potato Salad with Walnuts and Crown Daisy
_en.intro:
20231201, #breakfastdiary 909, -7°C/clear, 21min/workout(Y) 
This is the walnut and crown daisy anchovy potato salad recipe from the essay #themoresoicook, though I changed the amounts and order a bit. The recipe says to mash the potatoes first and then add the onion and crown daisy, but I find it easier to mix in liquids like butter, mayo, and yogurt first before folding in the rest. Turns out this dish works your forearms more than you'd expect, 💪
Ingredients: 3 potatoes, 1/2 onion, 2 stalks crown daisy, 1T butter, 2 anchovies, a small handful of walnuts, 2T mayo, 1T yogurt, plus salt and pepper
Boil the potatoes with the skin on, then peel while hot and mash. 
Mix in the anchovies, mayo, and yogurt evenly, then fold in the onion, crown daisy, and walnuts — adding the anchovies and tasting as you salt is best. A little pepper and some of the (leftover) anchovy oil rounds out the flavor nicely. 
Mound it generously on a plate and finish with scallions and a walnut piece

_en.title: Cucumber Salad
_en.intro:
20231130, #breakfastdiary 908, -7°C/clear
Ingredients: 1 cucumber, 4 radishes, 1/4 onion, 2T pumpkin seeds, vinaigrette (3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard) 
Slice the cucumber and radishes on a mandoline. Slice the onion and soak it in water ahead of time. Lightly toast the pumpkin seeds in a pan. 
In a bowl, combine the cucumber, radishes, onion, and pumpkin seeds, drizzle with the vinaigrette, and toss evenly. Really simple. 
From the #mylocalfoodsalad recipe.

title: 앤초비파스타 맛수령 파스타
intro:
20231129, #조식다이어리 907, -4도/대체로 흐림, 20분/운동(L) 
지난해 코로나에 걸리고 후각이 마비된 후 지금이야말로 (애써 비린내를 참을 필요 없으므로) 엔초비를 만들 수 있는 적기라고 생각해서 생멸치 1kg을 구입, 엔초비를 만들어 파스타까지 해 먹었으나 기대보단 맛이 없었다. 여기엔 갖가지 이유가 있는데 그건 다음에 정리하기로, 아무튼 엔초비는 사 먹자. 싸고 맛있다. 
재료: 마늘 3개, 방울토마토 2개, 앤초비 3~4개, 케이퍼는 10알 가량, 버터(넣으면 풍미 폭발🌋, 생략 가능), 파스타, 소금
이것은 오일 베이스 파스타이므로 달군 팬에 올리브 오일 충분히 두르고 약불에 케이퍼, 앤초비를 볶는다 혹은 데친다. 마늘과 토마토를 넣는다. 
면과 면수 한 컵 넣고 휘휘 젓다가 적당히 익으면 불을 끄고 버터 한 덩어리 넣고 휘휘 만테까레 후 접시에 담아서 맛있게~
*유튜브 #맛수령 레시피 입니다.

_en.title: Anchovy Pasta
_en.intro:
20231129, #breakfastdiary 907, -4°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/workout(L) 
After losing my sense of smell to COVID last year, I figured now was the perfect time (since I wouldn't have to fight through the fishy smell) to finally make anchovies myself, so I bought 1kg of fresh anchovies, cured them, and even made pasta with them — but it turned out less tasty than I'd hoped. There are several reasons for that, which I'll sort out another time, but for now: let's just buy anchovies. They're cheap and delicious. 
Ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, 2 cherry tomatoes, 3-4 anchovies, about 10 capers, butter (adds an explosion of flavor🌋, optional), pasta, salt
Since this is an oil-based pasta, heat plenty of olive oil in a pan and sauté or gently poach the capers and anchovies over low heat. Add the garlic and tomatoes. 
Add the pasta and a cup of pasta water, stir well, and once it's cooked through, turn off the heat, add a knob of butter, and mantecare by stirring vigorously before plating. Enjoy~
*Recipe from the YouTube channel #matsuryeong.

title: 모듬콩샐러드 콩
intro:
20231128, #조식다이어리 906, -4도/맑음, 21분/운동(U) 
엊그제 망원시장에서 천 원 주고 (주인장의 큐레이션 취향이 엿보이는) 모듬콩을 샀다. 최근에 구입식재료 가운데 가심비로는 최고다. 
모듬콩을 냄비에 넣고 20분 정도 삶는다. (완두콩은 금방 익기 때문에 나중에 넣는 것이 좋은데, 골라 낼 시간이 없어서 그냥 삶았다.)
접시에 담고 비네그레트 드레싱(올리브오일3, 와인비니거1, 홀그레인 머스타드0.5) , 후추후추, 민트나 고수, 파슬리가 있다면 곁들인다. 그들은 마치 건빵에 들어가는 별사탕 같은 존재들이다.

_en.title: Mixed Bean Salad
_en.intro:
20231128, #breakfastdiary 906, -4°C/clear, 21min/workout(U) 
A couple of days ago I picked up a bag of mixed beans for a thousand won at Mangwon Market — you could tell the shopkeeper had a real eye for curation. Lately it's been the best value-for-happiness ingredient I've bought. 
Put the mixed beans in a pot and boil for about 20 minutes. (Green peas cook fast, so ideally you'd add them later, but I didn't have time to sort them out, so I just boiled everything together.)
Plate it up and add vinaigrette (3 olive oil, 1 wine vinegar, 0.5 whole grain mustard), lots of pepper, and mint, cilantro, or parsley if you have any. They're like the little star candies tucked into a pack of hardtack biscuits.

title: 이슬아 고등어덮밥
intro:
20231127, #조식다이어리 905, 5도/이슬비
무언가를 멈추는 일이 장마철에 빗방울을 피하는 것만큼이나 어렵게 느껴지는 세상이다. 빠르고 잦은 소비를 부추기는 방향으로 설계된 이 시대에서 착취에 덜 가담하려면 의지와 기쁨이 필요하다. 죄책감만으로 바뀌는 데에는 한계가 있지 않던가. 마음을 틀어서 새로운 쾌락을 연습해야 할 때다.
#이슬아 작가의 말, (전문은 ‘덜 사는 기쁨을 찾아서’, 경향신문)
간장2, 맛술2, 설탕1, 다진마늘0.5, 물 반 컵 섞어서 소스를 만든다. 
팬에 고등어 올리고 소스 뿌려서 앞뒤로 굽고, 생선 비린내를 집아줄 실파를 다진다. (소스는 조금 남겨둔다.) 
그릇에 실파를 수북하게 담고 고등어 올리고 만들어 둔 소스를 드레싱처럼 고등어 위에 붓고 야무지게 다지고 골고루 비벼서 먹는다.

_en.title: Mackerel Rice Bowl
_en.intro:
20231127, #breakfastdiary 905, 5°C/drizzle
It's a world where stopping yourself feels as hard as dodging raindrops in the monsoon season. In an era designed to push fast, constant consumption, taking part in less exploitation takes both will and joy. Guilt alone can only carry you so far. It's time to redirect the mind and practice a new kind of pleasure.
Words from the writer #leeseula (full piece: 'In Search of the Joy of Buying Less,' The Kyunghyang Shinmun)
Mix 2 soy sauce, 2 cooking wine, 1 sugar, 0.5 minced garlic, and 1/2 cup water to make the sauce. 
Lay the mackerel in a pan, pour over the sauce, and sear both sides, then chop scallions to tame the fishy smell. (Save a little of the sauce.) 
Pile the scallions generously into a bowl, place the mackerel on top, pour the reserved sauce over it like a dressing, chop everything together thoroughly, and mix well before eating.

title: 수플레팬케이크 폴렌타샐러드 폴렌타
intro:

_en.title: Polenta Salad
_en.intro:
20231126, #breakfastdiary 904, -2°C/mostly cloudy, 21min/workout(Y) 
With only two eggs left, I set out to make a #soufflepancake — sifted the flour, measured the sugar, got everything ready to whip the meringue — but the moment I cracked the egg, the yolk broke. After staring blankly at the burst yolk for a moment, I pulled myself together, raided the fridge for leftover vegetables, and stir-fried them into today's breakfast instead: #polentasalad
Heat olive oil in a pan, add zucchini, onion, eggplant, and tomato, and stir-fry with plenty of salt, pepper, and herbs. 
In a pot, combine 1/2 cup polenta, 2 cups water, and salt; once it boils, turn off the heat and let it sit for a moment. 
Spoon the polenta onto a plate, top with the stir-fried vegetables, and enjoy~
From the #myfrenchstylesalad recipe. 
For when you have no appetite, don't feel like rice, or just because — #italiancornporridge #polenta
22g milk
35g soft flour

_en.intro:
20231125, #breakfastdiary 903, -3°C/clear
Made from ground chickpeas, cilantro, cumin, onion, and more, then deep-fried, falafel is one of the Middle East's signature vegan dishes. Someone once described its taste as 'like gathering up only the crispy edges of mung bean pancakes,' and I couldn't put it better myself. 
I roll the falafel 'dough' (?) I bought at the Asian market the other day into balls and deep-fry them. 
Mix mayo, lemon juice, and whole grain mustard in a 2:1:0.5 ratio to make a lemon mayo for dipping.

_en.title: Mama Drop the Noodles (Thai Noodle Salad)
_en.intro:
20231124, #breakfastdiary 902, -5°C/clear, 21min/workout(L)
Reel below ⬇️
https://www.instagram.com/reel/C0CB49Aphdh/?igshid=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==
A Thai restaurant in Yeonnam-dong (though it seems to have several branches now) — 
An homage to the #mamadropthenoodles I once had at #ssap
If you don't have Mama-brand ramen, any similarly sized instant noodle works, but somehow Mama ramen just feels like the real deal. 
Heat olive oil in a pan and blanch the shrimp with plenty of salt and pepper. 
Wash and cut the radish, mint, and cherry tomatoes and set aside. 
Mix fish sauce, lime juice, and coconut sugar in equal parts to make the dressing. (Fish sauce is a must; lime juice can be swapped for lemon juice, and coconut sugar for regular sugar, 😃)
Boil the Mama ramen, rinse in cold water, and drain. (Set the powdered soup packet aside for later.) 
Plate the noodles, stack on the prepared ingredients, and drizzle with the dressing. (Oh, I forgot the fried shallots — you could swap in something crispy like peanuts instead, 😃)

어제 오늘 슬로유뉴스 @slownewskr 엔 사다리가 등장한다. 
공정한 사다리, (혹은 우리가) 같은 출발선에서 출발한다는 착각을 일깨워 주는 “사다리야말로 부르주아적 발상의 완벽한 상징이다. 사다리는 개인적으로만 사용할 수 있는 장치다. 당신은 사다리를 혼자 올라간다.” 레이먼드 윌리엄스의 인용부터, 
잘린 게 엊그제였는데 금새 취업했다가 다시 원복에 성공한 오픈AI 샘 알트만 사태(?)의 이면엔, (알트만의 해고를 주도한) 수츠케버와 힌턴은 이미 한 번씩 큰돈을 만진 사람들”이고 “이들이 말하는 ‘인공지능의 안전한 발전’이 사다리 걷어차기라고 느꼈을 것” (그리고 알트만이 직원들의 압도적인 지지를 받고 있는 것 같지만 사실은 그가 추진했던 주식 공개 매수가 성공해야 직원들이 보유하고 있는 주식을 비싸게 팔 수 있기 때문이라는 해석까지)

_en.intro:
20231123, #breakfastdiary 901, 9°C/partly cloudy, 21min/workout(Y)
Yesterday and today's Slow News @slownewskr talks about ladders. 
Starting with a quote from Raymond Williams that shakes loose the illusion of a fair ladder (or of all of us starting from the same line): 'The ladder is a perfect symbol of bourgeois thought — it is a device that can only be used individually. You climb the ladder alone.' 
Behind the whole OpenAI Sam Altman affair(?) — fired one moment, rehired and reinstated the next — lies the fact that 'Sutskever and Hinton, who led his ouster, are people who have already cashed in big once themselves,' and 'what they call the safe development of AI probably felt to them like someone kicking the ladder out from under them.' (And there's also the reading that Altman only seems to have the employees' overwhelming support because the tender offer he pushed for needs to succeed so employees can sell their shares at a high price.)
A barrier-free breakfast that needs no ladder and no wall: #persimmongreekyogurt

Pan-toasted walnuts and pumpkin seeds, and mint🍃

면과 페스토를 넣고 만테까레 과정을 거친 게 아니니 이건 파스타가 아니라 페스토 비빔 샐러드다. 
바질 페스토 펜네 샐러드
끓는 물에 소금 조금, 펜네를 삶고 건져서 들러붙지 않도록 올리브 오일을 뿌려둔다. 
애호박은 반달 모양으로 썰고 방울 토마토는 네 조각으로 썬 다음 달군 팬에 올리브 오일 두르고 소금소금, 후추후추 굽는다. 
펜네에 구운 애호박과 토마토, 바질 페스토 넣어서 골고루 섞는다. 파마산 치즈를 갈아 넣는다. 
#나의프랑스식샐러드 레시피를 응용했습니다.

_en.title: Basil Pesto Penne Salad
_en.intro:
20231122, #breakfastdiary 900, 3°C/clear, 21min/workout(U)
Since I didn't run the noodles and pesto through a proper mantecare, this isn't really pasta — it's more of a pesto-tossed salad. 
Basil Pesto Penne Salad
Boil the penne in salted water, drain, and toss with a little olive oil so it doesn't stick together. 
Cut the zucchini into half-moons and the cherry tomatoes into quarters, then sear both in a hot pan with olive oil, plenty of salt, and pepper. 
Toss the penne with the seared zucchini and tomatoes and the basil pesto until evenly combined. Grate in some parmesan. 
Adapted from the #myfrenchstylesalad recipe.

title: 비트
intro:
20231121, #조식다이어리 899, 1도/맑음
이거 반 개 먹고 아침 식사가 되는지 묻는 분들이 있는데 비트는 뿌리 채소라서 고구마나 감자 같은 포만감이 있다. 
단맛이 도는 비트에 그릭 요거트도 좋고 리코타 치즈 조합도 좋다. 민트 곁들여 먹으면 재밌는 맛이 난다. 
그릭 요거트 비트 샐러드
비트 한 개 껍질채 물에 씻어 반으로 가르고 1시간 정도 푹 삶는다. 
가운데를 숟가락으로 파내고 그릭 요거트를 담는다. 올리브오일, 후추후추, 민트잎을 올린다. 
#나의프랑스식샐러드 레시피 입니다.

_en.title: Greek Yogurt Beet Salad
_en.intro:
20231121, #breakfastdiary 899, 1°C/clear
Some people ask whether half a beet is really enough to count as breakfast, but beets are root vegetables, so they're filling in the same way sweet potatoes or potatoes are. 
That naturally sweet beet pairs beautifully with Greek yogurt, and just as well with ricotta. Adding mint makes for a fun twist on the flavor. 
Greek Yogurt Beet Salad
Wash a whole beet with the skin on, cut it in half, and boil until tender, about an hour. 
Scoop out the center with a spoon and fill with Greek yogurt. Top with olive oil, plenty of pepper, and mint leaves. 
From the #myfrenchstylesalad recipe.

title: 두부 양송이버섯
intro:
20231120, #조식다이어리 898, 1도/맑음, 21분/운동(P) 
무릇 식재료를 위로 쌓으면 파인 다이닝이 된다. 
팬에 올리브 오일 듬뿍 두르고 양송이 버섯을 썰어 넣는다. 버섯이 오일을 많이 먹는다. 
간장1, 맛술1, 올리고당1 넣고 드레싱을 만들어 팬에 붓고 졸인다. 불끄기 전에 참기름1 넣어 향을 입힌다. 
에어 프라이어에 올리브 오일 둘러 두부 한 모 따뜻하게 데우고 접시에 담은 뒤 만들어 놓은 양송이 버섯, 대파, 참깨 올리고 참기름 한 방울로 마무리~ 💧
—
모르겠습니다.
어떤 때, 얼마만큼 졸여야 하는지...
너무 졸이지 않아서 지쳐 돌아간 사람도 있고,
너무 일찍 열어서 놀라 돌아간 사람도 있습니다.
너무 작게 열어 날 몰라준 사람도 있고,
너무 많이 열어 내가 지쳐버린 때도 있습니다.
나는 아직 잘 모르겠습니다.

_en.title: Tofu with Braised Mushrooms
_en.intro:
20231120, #breakfastdiary 898, 1°C/clear, 21min/workout(P) 
Stack your ingredients up high enough and any dish becomes fine dining. 
Pour plenty of olive oil into a pan and add sliced button mushrooms. Mushrooms soak up a surprising amount of oil. 
Mix 1 soy sauce, 1 cooking wine, and 1 oligo syrup to make a sauce, pour it into the pan, and let it reduce. Right before turning off the heat, stir in 1 sesame oil for aroma. 
Drizzle olive oil in the air fryer and warm a block of tofu, then plate it, top with the prepared mushrooms, scallions, and sesame seeds, and finish with a drop of sesame oil~ 💧
—
I still don't know.
When, and by how much, you're supposed to reduce it...
Some people left exhausted because I didn't reduce it enough,
and some left startled because I opened up too soon.
Some never got to know me because I opened only a little,
and sometimes I wore myself out from opening too much.
I still don't really know.

title: 당근
intro:
20231119, #조식다이어리 897, 7도/부분적으로 흐림, 20분/운동(Y)
깻잎과 부라타치즈를 곁들인 당근구이
당근 한 개 (쌈장에 찍어 먹는 크기로) 썰고 올리브오일, 소금소금 해서 180도 오븐에 30분 굽는다. 
(30분 동안 요가를 한다,🧘‍♂️)
꿀, 스리라차, 레몬주스 넣어 드레싱을 만들어 구운 당근에 붓고 골고루 섞은 뒤 180도 오븐에, 이번엔 5분 굽는다. 이맘때쯤 풍기는 당근 향이 일품이다.
접시에 구운 당근, 다진 깻잎, 부라타 치즈, 구운 호박씨를 차례대로 담는다. 
호박씨는 팬에 구우면 고소함이 폭발한다.

_en.title: Roasted Carrots with Burrata
_en.intro:
20231119, #breakfastdiary 897, 7°C/partly cloudy, 20min/workout(Y)
Roasted Carrots with Perilla Leaves and Burrata
Cut a carrot into pieces (about ssamjang-dipping size), toss with olive oil and plenty of salt, and roast in a 180°C oven for 30 minutes. 
(I do yoga for those 30 minutes, 🧘‍♂️)
Mix honey, sriracha, and lemon juice to make a dressing, pour it over the roasted carrots, toss evenly, and roast again in the 180°C oven, this time for 5 minutes. The carrot aroma at this point is out of this world. 
On a plate, layer the roasted carrots, chopped perilla leaves, burrata, and toasted pumpkin seeds. 
Toasting the pumpkin seeds in a pan makes them explosively nutty.

title: 롱블랙 바게틴 토스트
intro:
20231118, #조식다이어리 896, 0도/맑음
전념 밖에 있을 때, 우리는 무언가에 전념하는 게 두렵습니다. 그러나 막상 전념의 세계, 헌신의 상태로 들어서고 나면 오히려 편안합니다. 매일 달리며 글을 쓰는 소설가 무라카미 하루키처럼, 어떻게 매일 연습했냐는 질문에 “그냥 했어요”라고 답했던 김연아 선수처럼, 헌신은 우리를 편안하고 단순하며, 확실한 삶으로 안내해요.
#롱블랙 @longblack.co , 전념 : 무한 탐색의 시대에, 온 마음을 쏟아 나를 던진다는 것
20년 7월 13일부터 특별한 일이 없으면 거의 매일 아침을 만들고 있다. 하루를 시작하는 리추얼이며 어느 순간부터는 헌신이고 전념이다. 어떻게 그럴 수 있냐는 질문에 대한 답은 늘 같다. 그냥 하고 있다. 
팬을 달구고 #바게틴 @baguettine.seoul 깜빠뉴에 올리브오일 둘러 앞뒤로 굽는다. 
괴카몰을 만들어보자. 냉동 아보카도 두 컵 준비한다. (혹은 으깰 것이므로 후숙될 수록 좋은, 다시 말해 상하기 직전의 아보카도 한 개 준비해서 반으로 가르고 껍질 벗겨서 준비해도 된다.)
아보카도는 포크로 으깨고 방울토마토는 1/4등분 속을 파내고 다진다. 소금 한 꼬집, 후추후추후추, 라임주스 1t 
계란 한 개, 써니사이드 업으로 준비한다. 
토스트, 어셈블! 
깜빠뉴에 과카몰 골고루 처발처발, 계란프라이 올린 뒤 레드페퍼로 마무리~

_en.title: Guacamole Toast
_en.intro:
20231118, #breakfastdiary 896, 0°C/clear
When we're standing outside of commitment, we're afraid to commit to anything. But once we actually step into that world of devotion, it turns out to be surprisingly comfortable. Like novelist Haruki Murakami, who runs and writes every single day, or figure skater Kim Yuna, who answered 'I just did it' when asked how she practiced every day — devotion leads us to a life that's calm, simple, and certain.
#longblack @longblack.co, 'Commitment: Throwing Your Whole Self In, In an Age of Endless Searching'
Since July 13th of [20]20, I've been making breakfast almost every single morning unless something special comes up. It's the ritual that starts my day, and at some point it became devotion, commitment. Whenever someone asks how I manage that, my answer is always the same: I just do it. 
Heat a pan, brush olive oil onto #baguettine @baguettine.seoul campagne bread, and toast both sides. 
Let's make guacamole. Prepare two cups of frozen avocado. (Or, since you'll be mashing it anyway, one very ripe — practically about-to-spoil — avocado works too; just halve and peel it.)
Mash the avocado with a fork. Quarter the cherry tomatoes, scoop out the seeds, and dice. Add a pinch of salt, plenty of pepper, and 1t lime juice. 
Prepare one egg, sunny-side up. 
Toast, assemble! 
Spread the guacamole generously over the campagne bread, top with the fried egg, and finish with red pepper flakes~

title: 피넛버터드레싱메밀국수 피넛버터 메밀국수
intro:
20231117, #조식다이어리 895, -1도/대체로 맑음, 21분/운동(Y) 
땅콩버터는 단백질, 단일불포화지방, 비타민E, 나이아신, 마그네슘 등이 함유돼 있지만 칼로리가 높아 하루 2스푼 이내로 먹어야 한다고 강재헌 강북삼성병원 가정의학과 교수님이 말씀하셨다. 
의사 선생님의 하루 권장량은 2t(스푼)인데 이미 꾹꾹 눌러담아 2T를 먹었다. 오늘 오전에 예정된 일 외에 북악산을 올라야 할 이유가 하나 더 생겼다. 🧗
피넛버터 2T, 다진 마늘 1/2t, 간장 2T, 식초 2T, 참기름 1T를 섞어 드레싱을 만든다. 취향에 따라 매실청, 유차청을 1T 더한다. 대파를 다진다.

_en.title: Buckwheat Noodles with Peanut Butter Dressing
_en.intro:
20231117, #breakfastdiary 895, -1°C/mostly clear, 21min/workout(Y) 
Peanut butter contains protein, monounsaturated fat, vitamin E, niacin, and magnesium, but it's also high in calories, so Dr. Kang Jae-heon, a family medicine professor at Kangbuk Samsung Hospital, says you should keep it under 2 spoonfuls a day. 
The doctor's recommended daily amount is 2t (spoons), but I'd already packed in a heaping 2T. Now, on top of my plans for this morning, I have one more reason to go hike Bugaksan. 🧗
Mix 2T peanut butter, 1/2t minced garlic, 2T soy sauce, 2T vinegar, and 1T sesame oil to make the dressing. Add 1T plum syrup or yuja syrup if you like. Chop the scallions. 
Boil the buckwheat noodles, pouring in cold water a few times to cool the pot as you go. 
Plate the noodles, top with the peanut butter dressing and scallions, and mix well before eating.

_en.title: Scallion and Egg Rice Bowl
_en.intro:
20231116, #breakfastdiary 894, 4°C/cloudy, 26min/workout(L) 
It doesn't look like anything that should cause a stir, and yet apparently #scallioneggricebowl blew up on Instagram
Heat Okhee Mill @okhee_mill perilla oil in a pan and stir-fry chopped scallions. Frying scallions in soybean oil gives off that Chinese-restaurant fried-rice smell, but perilla oil is a completely different, fragrant thing. 
Once the scallions are cooked through, build a little barrier so the eggs can't escape, crack in two eggs, and let them sit until set. 
Carefully spoon the scallion-and-egg mixture over warm rice, then finish with a spoonful of soy sauce, a little perilla oil, and sesame seeds.

_en.title: Calamares al Ajillo
_en.intro:
20231114, #breakfastdiary 892, -1°C/partly cloudy, 21min/workout(C) 
What's usually called gambas — Gambas al ajillo — but with squid in place of shrimp, so I suppose this one should be called Calamares al ajillo instead. 
In Korea we call it gambas🍤, and in Japan they call it ahiyo apparently, 🧄
Gently poach whole garlic cloves in olive oil over low heat in a pan, then add pepperoncino and the squid I'd prepped the night before. 
(Parsley would be nice, but since I don't have any) chop up some perilla leaves instead and add those. Once it's cooked through, add lemon juice, plenty of salt and pepper, transfer to a plate, and enjoy with campagne bread. 
—
Calamares instead of gambas this time, #calamaresalajillo
A la plancha is a Spanish style of cooking where various ingredients are seared in a pan with olive oil or butter. Grilled shrimp is Gambas a la Plancha, and grilled squid is Calamares a la Plancha. 
What's usually called gambas is Gambas al ajillo

_en.title: Avocado Mushroom Toast
_en.intro:
20231113, #breakfastdiary 891, -4°C/crystal clear, 20min/workout(U) 
Made from nothing but flour, water, yeast, and salt, campagne bread used to be a French staple. Because it's a fermented dough, it's said to have less gluten, digest more easily, and have a lower glycemic index. 
There's a theory that the bread Jean Valjean stole was a campagne loaf, though there's no way to confirm it. Back then France had both baguettes and campagne, so it would have been one or the other — though wouldn't a baguette have been easier to run off with? 
Heat a pan and toast Baguettine @baguettine.seoul campagne bread with a drizzle of olive oil. 
Add vertically sliced mushrooms and stir-fry with plenty of salt and pepper, then toss in a little scallion. 
Mash the avocado onto the bread and top with the mushrooms you just made. 
Mushroom asked if it could be sautéed and piled onto toast,
and I said okay. 
As long as it's with avocado,
I'm all in, trust me~

_en.title: Scallion Salad
_en.intro:
20231112, #breakfastdiary 890, -1°C/crystal clear, 27min/workout(U) 
If you're still only tossing scallions into ramen, try this instead: 
(from here you have to read it all in one breath) allicin binds with vitamin B1 in the body to boost metabolism and ease fatigue, flavonoids help improve bronchial health, vitamin C helps prevent colds while also lowering cholesterol to protect against cardiovascular disease, and it even contains calcium to keep your joints healthy — all from scallions, so, 
wash and trim them, lay them in a pan, and drizzle with olive oil. Sear both sides and add plenty of pepper.

_en.title: Vegetable Soup
_en.intro:
20231111, #breakfastdiary 889, 0°C/cloudy, 26min/workout(L) - Lower body day after a long while, my legs feel like they're about to fall off. 
A heavily peppered vegetable soup anyone can throw together from whatever's in the fridge

_en.title: Braised Radish
_en.intro:
20231110, #breakfastdiary 888, 0°C/partly cloudy
A little while back in Guangzhou, I spotted a genuinely gorgeous, good-looking radish and fell for it at first sight — and just now the right recipe caught my eye, so I'm bringing it to breakfast. 
Slice the radish into 2cm-thick rounds, trim off a thick layer of skin, and score both sides. Boil thoroughly for about 20-30 minutes. 
Mix mayo, gochujang, and egg yolk to make the sauce. 
Poke the radish to check it's cooked through, drain, place on a baking tray, spoon the sauce on top, and bake in a 180°C oven for 10-20 minutes. Finish with chopped scallions~

title: 시나몬애플오버나이트오트 오트밀 오버나이트오트
intro:
20231108, #조식다이어리 886, 2도/맑음, 21분/운동(Y) 
냉장고에서 하룻밤 재운 오트로 만든 #시나몬애플오버나이트오트
어젯밤에 오트 100g에 우유 250ml 붓고 하룻밤 냉장고에 뒀다. 우유가 조금 많지 않나 싶었는데 아침에 확인해 보니 적당한 양이다. 
팬에 버터 한 덩어리 넣고 작은 큐브 모양으로 썬 사과, 시나몬 넣고 데친다. 사과는 구울 수록 몸에 좋은 성분이 증가한다. 
볼에 오트밀, 구운 사과, 오트, 그릭요거트 순으로 올리고 구운 사과를 조금 올린다. 메이플시럽으로 마무리~😋
-
츌장 가는 비행기에서 읽은 책 #초급한국어 엔 이런 대목이 있었다. 
우리는 아이온에 둘러싸인 채 크로노스 속을 살아가는 존재다. 무심하지만 규칙적으로 흐르는 크로노스를 좀처럼 벗어날 수 없는 시간 감옥의 죄수이기도 하다. 하지만 삶에는 가끔씩 크로노스가 찾아오는데, 이를테면 화살이 날아가거나 아이가 태어나는 순간 같은 것들이 그렇다. 이전과 이후가 갈라지고, 한번 일어나면 결코 그 이전으로는 돌아갈 수 없는 시간.
따라서 시간을 묻는 방법은 두 가지여야만 한다.
1 크로노스를 물을 때: 지금 몇 시예요?
2 카이로스를 물을 때: 그건 어떤 시간이었나요?
-

_en.title: Cinnamon Apple Overnight Oats
_en.intro:
20231108, #breakfastdiary 886, 2°C/sunny, 21min/exercise(Y)
Overnight oats soaked in the fridge — #cinnamonappleovernightoats
Last night I poured 250ml milk over 100g oats and left it in the fridge overnight. I worried the milk might be a bit much, but checking this morning, it turned out to be just the right amount.
In a pan, melt a knob of butter and cook small apple cubes with cinnamon. The more you cook apples, the more beneficial compounds they develop.
In a bowl, layer oatmeal, the cooked apple, oats, and Greek yogurt, then top with a bit more of the cooked apple. Finish with maple syrup~😋
-
On the flight to my business trip, I read a passage in the book #BeginnerKorean that stuck with me.
We are beings who live within Chronos, surrounded by Aion. We are prisoners of a time-prison we can hardly escape, one that flows indifferently but regularly. But every so often, Kairos visits our lives too — moments like an arrow flying through the air, or a child being born. Moments where before and after split apart, and once they happen, there's no going back to before.
So there should be two ways to ask about time.
1 Asking about Chronos: What time is it now?
2 Asking about Kairos: What kind of time was that?

One of China's classic breakfast staples — youtiao and doujiang.
They're written 油(oil)条(stick), pronounced you+tiao, and 豆(bean)醤(sauce), pronounced dou+jiang.
Youtiao brings to mind a Korean sugar-twist doughnut (kkwabaegi) that hasn't been rolled in sugar, but it's much chewier and nuttier. Doujiang, as the name suggests, is close to a savory soy milk. The pairing of savory-on-savory is quite a charming combination.

_en.title: Gochujang Mac and Cheese
_en.intro:
20231028, #breakfastdiary 880, 13°C/sunny
A rendezvous between nutty, salty mac and cheese and spicy gochujang 😃
In a hot pan, melt a knob of butter with a little minced garlic, sizzle-sizzle, then add a spoonful of flour and half a spoonful of gochujang, sizzle-sizzle again.
Once it's mixed well, lower the heat and pour in 3 cups of milk a little at a time, whisking until smooth. Add 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese and melt it in. (Taste and season with salt.) Add the boiled macaroni and mix well. #gochujangmacandcheese
*The key to mac and cheese is a thick texture and a nutty, savory-salty flavor. Adjust the consistency with milk and the seasoning with salt.

새 신부 쥬노는 리토의 마을이 따분하다며 새 신랑이 이혼당하고 싶지 않으면 #구운사과 정도는 갖다 바쳐야 하는 것 아니냐며 투덜거린다.

그래, 사과는 껍질 채 구워먹는 과일이었어, 
사과 한 개 잘라서 달군 팬에 올리고 시나몬 솔솔솔 뿌려서 앞뒤로 굽는다. 볼에 그릭요거트, 시나몬, 구운 사과를 넣고 호두를 곁들인다.
*시간과 체중 관리에 대한 부담이 덜하시다면, 호두는 팬에 한 번 굽고 먹기 전에 메이플 시럽을 더하실 것

_en.title: Baked Apple
_en.intro:
20231027, #breakfastdiary 879, 11°C/partly cloudy, 21min/exercise(Y)
The newlywed Juno grumbles that Rito Village is boring, and that her new husband had better bring back at least a #bakedapple if he doesn't want to get divorced.
(Before questioning whether that's really grounds for such anger,) the more you bake an apple, the more its antioxidants and pectin content increase, which slows insulin release and helps prevent fat from building up. Especially if you bake it without peeling, you get more than double the nutritional benefit.
So it turns out apples were meant to be baked with the skin on all along.
Cut an apple in half, place it in a hot pan, sprinkle on cinnamon, and grill both sides. In a bowl, combine Greek yogurt, cinnamon, and the baked apple, and top with walnuts.
*If you're not too worried about time or watching your weight, toast the walnuts in the pan once and add maple syrup right before eating.
—
Do you know how to make a baked apple?
In the game, you just leave it by a campfire, but in real life you have to cook it in a pan.
In The Legend of Zelda, eating a baked apple restores +0.75 hearts.

_en.title: Perilla Oil Tofu
_en.intro:
20231024, #breakfastdiary 876, 10°C/mostly cloudy, 21min/exercise(Y)
Park Hyatt's Le Labo Bergamote 22, Singapore Airlines' Stefan Floridian Waters, the scent of books at Kyobo Bookstore — welcome to the world of scent marketing. And now, add the smell of tofu frying in perilla oil.
Take a block of tofu, pat it dry, and cut it into thirds.
In a hot pan, add a generous pour of perilla oil from Okhee's Mill @okhee_mill and fry the tofu. (Turning it to fry one side at a time keeps its shape intact and makes for a prettier result.)
Plate it and top with chopped perilla leaves, sesame seeds, and a little soy sauce — a breakfast that's as good to smell as it is to eat.

title: 소브레메사 토마토밥
intro:
20231023, #조식다이어리 875, 11도/부분적으로흐림, 21분/운동(Y) 
#소브레메사 #Sobremesa 영어에는 적합한 단어가 없지만 그 개념은 간단하다. 식사를 마친 후 당신이 테이블에서 보내는 시간을 뜻한다. 보통 웃음소리가 포함되고 거의 항상 편안하고 명랑한 대화가 오간다. (출처: BBC) 
혼자, 햄버거나 샐러드처럼 컴팩트하고 효율적인 식사가 대부분인 요즘 사람들에게 이런 얘기는 참으로 생경하기 짝이 없다. 
토마토에 칼집을 내고 끓는 물에 데친 후 찬 물에 담가 껍질을 벗긴다. 
따뜻한 밥 위에 토마토를 얹고 올리브 조금, 소금, 올리브오일을 넣고 적당히 섞는다. 
입맛 없을 때, 시간 없을 때, 귀찮을 때 간단하지만 풍요로운 조식이다.

_en.title: Sobremesa Tomato Rice
_en.intro:
20231023, #breakfastdiary 875, 11°C/partly cloudy, 21min/exercise(Y)
#Sobremesa — there's no perfect word for it in English, but the concept is simple: it's the time you spend at the table after finishing a meal. It usually involves laughter, and almost always a relaxed, cheerful conversation. (Source: BBC)
For most of us today, eating alone and favoring compact, efficient meals like burgers or salads, this idea feels almost foreign.
Score a tomato, blanch it in boiling water, then dip it in cold water and peel off the skin.
Place the tomato over warm rice, add a few olives, salt, and olive oil, and mix gently.
When you have no appetite, no time, or just can't be bothered — this is a simple yet rich breakfast.

title: 스콘
intro:
20231022, #조식다이어리 874, 3도/맑음
마른 기침 때문에 일찍 깼다. 햇살도 좋고 마침 먹어(치워)야 할 클로티드 크림이 있으니 따뜻한 한 입 스콘을 만들어 볼까? 
한 입 스콘 6개 분량 레시피, 
중력분150g, 설탕30g, 베이킹파우더1t, 소금은 약간, 계량해서 섞는다. 버터30g 조각내서 계량한 가루와 섞는다. 
우유50ml, 계란1개 넣고 뒤섞뒤섞, 가루에 부어 반죽을 한다. (우유, 계란 섞은 건 조금 남겨둔다.) 잘 싸서 냉장고에 30분 정도 둔다. 
반죽을 꺼내서 밀대로 밀고 무스틀로 찍어서 플레이트에 올리고 남겨둔 우유, 계란 섞은 걸 바른다. 170도 오븐에 15분 정도. 굽는다. 
반을 잘라 잼, 크림 순서로 바른다.

_en.title: Scones
_en.intro:
20231022, #breakfastdiary 874, 3°C/sunny
I woke up early because of a dry cough. The sun was out, and I happened to have some clotted cream that needed using up, so why not make some warm bite-sized scones?
Recipe for 6 bite-sized scones:
Measure out 150g all-purpose flour, 30g sugar, 1t baking powder, and a pinch of salt, and mix together. Cut 30g butter into pieces and work it into the measured dry ingredients.
Add 50ml milk and 1 egg, mix well, then pour into the dry ingredients and knead into a dough. (Set aside a little of the milk-egg mixture.) Wrap it well and let it rest in the fridge for about 30 minutes.
Take out the dough, roll it out with a rolling pin, cut rounds with a mousse ring, place them on a tray, and brush with the reserved milk-egg mixture. Bake in a 170°C oven for about 15 minutes.
Cut in half and spread with jam, then cream.

_en.title: Carrot Rapé Bagel
_en.intro:
20231020, #breakfastdiary 872, 9°C/sunny
Comparing 2019 to 2022, bagel shops led the growth among dessert specialty stores by a landslide, at 216%. (For reference: rice cakes/traditional sweets 66%, waffles/pies 65%.) And apparently you still have to wait in line for over an hour just to get takeout at the London Bagel Museum these days. Well, if that's the case —
Come to My Breakfast Bagel Museum instead!
Julienne one carrot, sprinkle with salt, and let it sit for about 10 minutes.
Add 3 parts olive oil, 1 part lemon juice, 1 part wine vinegar, and 1/2 part wholegrain mustard, mix well, and make #carrotrape.
Cut the bagel in half, toast at 180°C for 5 minutes, spread generously with ricotta cheese, and top with the carrot rapé.

title: 창직 퍼스널브랜딩 콜리플라워
intro:
20231019, #조식다이어리 871, 16도/비
방송인 이영자가 광고해 히트친 50계 치킨 알지? 매일 깨끗한 새 기름으로 60마리만 조리하며 기름을 재사용하지 않는다잖아. 얼마 전에 치킨 사업하는 분을 만났는데, 그분이 억울하다는 듯 "교수님, 치킨은 어차피 60마리밖에 못 튀겨요. 저희는 진작부터 걸러낸 기름은 사용하지 않아요" 그러시더라.
그런데 중요한 건 뭐야? 먼저 말하는 게 임자거든. 업계 최초로 60마리만 조리한다는 사실이 중요한 게 아니라, 그 렇게 한다고 최초로 '인식'시키는 게 중요하단 말이지.
(홍성태, 브랜드로 남는다는 것)
한때 유행했던 #창직 을 이런 맥락으로 해석할 수 있겠다. 물론 요샌 좀 더 브로드한 #퍼스널브랜딩 이란 용어가 더 널리 통용되는 것 같다. 
고형분 카레 한 조각 넣고 물 300ml, 코코넛밀크가 없으므로 우유 150ml를 넣고 팔팔 끓인다. (다음 번엔 루를 넣어 좀 더 걸죽한 질감을 내기로,) 
#콜리플라워 와 어젯 밤에 불려 둔 #병아리콩 을 넣고 좀 더 끓인다. 시금치 넣고 살짝 저은 뒤 먹기 전에 레드 페퍼 조금~

_en.title: Cauliflower & Chickpea Curry
_en.intro:
20231019, #breakfastdiary 871, 16°C/rain
You know that '50-Chicken' fried chicken that TV personality Lee Young-ja advertised and turned into a hit? The pitch is that they only fry 60 chickens a day, always in fresh oil, never reused. I recently met someone in the chicken business who complained, almost indignantly, "Professor, no fryer can handle more than 60 chickens a day anyway — we've never reused filtered oil either."
But here's the thing that matters: whoever says it first, owns it. It's not the fact that they were the first in the industry to cook only 60 chickens that matters — it's that they were the first to make people 'perceive' it that way.
(Hong Seong-tae, "What Makes a Brand Last")
The once-trendy term #careercreation could be read in this same light. These days, though, the broader term #personalbranding seems to be more widely used.
Add a piece of solid curry roux, then pour in 300ml water and, since I don't have coconut milk, 150ml milk, and bring to a boil. (Next time I'll add a flour roux for a thicker texture.)
Add the #cauliflower and the #chickpeas I soaked overnight, and let it simmer a bit longer. Stir in the spinach lightly, and finish with a bit of red pepper flakes right before eating.

title: 브리치즈사과토스트
intro:
20231016, #조식다이어리 868, 9도/맑음, 54분/운동(W, Y) 
일주일 사이에 아침 기온이 한 자리 숫자로 바뀌었다. 아직은 가을, 겨울의 길목이다. 어서 오라, 겨울! 
달군 팬에 올리브오일 두른 빵을 굽고 브리치즈를 올린다. 오늘은 토치로 브리치즈를 구웠다. (빵이 함께 타버린다는 문제가 있긴 했으나 냉장고에서 갓 꺼낸 브리치즈와는 다른 훨씬 더 풍부한 식감을 맛볼 수 있다.) 
브리치즈와 최고의 궁합, 사과 반 개 잘라서 올리고 꿀, 호두로 마무리~

_en.title: Brie and Apple Toast
_en.intro:
20231016, #breakfastdiary 868, 9°C/sunny, 54min/exercise(W, Y)
In just a week, morning temperatures dropped to single digits. Still autumn, but we're at winter's doorstep now. Come on in, winter!
Toast bread brushed with olive oil in a hot pan, then top with brie. Today I torched the brie. (The bread ended up getting a bit charred in the process, but the texture was so much richer than brie fresh out of the fridge.)
Brie's best match — half an apple, sliced and layered on top — finished with honey and walnuts~

_en.title: Tomato Som Tam
_en.intro:
20231005, #breakfastdiary 865, 9°C/sunny
Cut cherry tomatoes into a bowl, add a mild #somtam dressing (a little minced garlic, 2-3 pepperoncini, red pepper flakes, 1 part fish sauce, 1/2 part sugar, 1 part lime juice), and lightly crush the tomatoes.
Add green beans, corn, carrot, and grapefruit blanched in boiling water, and toss well. Thought it'd be fun to have a bit of crunch here and there, so I finished with fried shallots (mostly because I was out of peanuts).

title: 타코 무화과
intro:
20231004, #조식다이어리 864, 13도/부분적으로흐림
헐리우드 작가 조합이 파업을 끝냈다. 결론은 다음 세 가지, 
1. 저작권료 인상 
2. 제작현장에 '집필 공간 Writing room'을 두고 작가를 상주시킬 것 
3. 대본 작업에 AI를 사용할 때 작가 보호 조치를 도입할 것
항간에서는 21세기판 러다이트 운동 아니냐는 비판도 있지만 새로 나오는 기술이 생활의 개선과 삶의 진보를 향하고 있는지는 늘 경계할 일이다. 
달군 팬에 올리브오일, 소금, 후추, 굴소스를 더해 버섯을 데친다. 흡사 고기 비주얼이다. 
팬에 또띠아를 살짝 데운 후 접시에 담고 아삭함을 더해 줄 양파를 조금 썰어서 물에 담가 두었다가 얹는다. (냉동) 아보카도에 소금, 후추, 라임주스 넣고 다져서 올리고, 토마토도 얹는다. 드레싱으로 마무리, 반으로 접어서 두 손에 쥐고 야무지게 먹는다.

_en.title: Mushroom Tacos & Figs
_en.intro:
20231004, #breakfastdiary 864, 13°C/partly cloudy
The Hollywood writers' guild ended its strike. The three main outcomes were:
1. Higher residuals/pay
2. A 'writers room' on set where writers stay through production
3. Protections for writers when AI is used in script work
Some call it a 21st-century Luddite movement, but it's always worth staying alert to whether new technology is actually moving life and society forward.
In a hot pan, cook mushrooms with olive oil, salt, pepper, and oyster sauce — the visual is almost like meat.
Warm a tortilla in the pan, plate it, and top with a little sliced onion (soaked in water first for extra crunch). Chop up (frozen) avocado with salt, pepper, and lime juice and add it on, then top with tomato. Finish with dressing, fold in half, and eat with both hands, no holding back.

title: 스팸덮밥 스팸
intro:
20231002, #조식다이어리 862, 17도/맑음, 60분/운동(W, C)
따뜻한 밥에 스팸 한 조각 🙂
해외에서 정크푸드 취급을 받는 스팸이 국내에선, 명절에 주고받는 선물이 됐다는 것, (전체 매출의 약 60%가 설과 추석에 집중되어 있다고,) 그건 전적으로 마케팅의 승리다. 
스팸의 앞면은 세로로, 뒷면은 대각선으로 칼집을 내서 팬에 굽는다. (적절히 두껍게 잘라야 분해되지 않는다.) 
갓지은 밥 위에 스팸, 실파 그리고 참기름 조금, #스팸덮밥

_en.title: Spam Rice Bowl
_en.intro:
20231002, #breakfastdiary 862, 17°C/sunny, 60min/exercise(W, C)
A slice of Spam over warm rice 🙂
Spam gets treated as junk food abroad, but in Korea it's become a holiday gift people give each other — about 60% of its total sales are concentrated around Lunar New Year and Chuseok. That's a complete marketing win.
Score the front of the Spam vertically and the back diagonally, then fry it in a pan. (Cut it thick enough or it'll fall apart.)
Over freshly cooked rice, add the Spam, chopped green onion, and a bit of sesame oil. #spamricebowl

_en.title: Yum Woon Sen
_en.intro:
20230930, #breakfastdiary 860, 20°C/mostly cloudy, 68min/exercise(W, H)
Yes, this is the taste — hometown flavor, take two. A warm Thai salad, yum woon sen.
Make the dressing with 3 parts lime juice, 2 parts sugar, 2 parts fish sauce, 2 parts chili sauce, and 1/2 part garlic.
Slice shallots and tomato and set aside, then blanch shrimp, squid, and glass noodles in boiling water.
On a plate, pile up the warm glass noodles with plenty of cilantro, onion, tomato, shrimp, and squid, then pour over the dressing. Finish with peanuts and fried shallots for extra crunch~
🤔 This isn't quite the real yum woon sen dressing — I just used one I found floating around online 🥲. I'll look into it more and try again later~

title: 프리타타 계란 시금치
intro:
20230926, #조식다이어리 856, 19도/비
형식이 내용을 규정한다. 양이 많지 않아 사각팬으로 바꿨더니 식빵 같은 프리타타가 됐다. 
달군 팬에 올리브오일, 양파, 시금치를 넣고 볶는다.
계란 3개 풀어서 우유 조금, 소금, 후추 넣고 섞어서 팬에 붓는다. 방울토마토와 부라타치즈를 찢어 넣는다. 
대충 익은 걸 확인하고 접시를 덮어 (영차,) 뒤집는다. 팬에 올리브오일 두르고 반대편을 굽는다. 
다시 뒤집어 접시에 놓는다. 
무릇 #프리타타 는 이 정도로 찐하게 익혀야 제맛이다.

_en.title: Egg and Spinach Frittata
_en.intro:
20230926 #breakfastdiary 856, 19°C/rainy
Form dictates content. Since the portion wasn't much, I switched to a square pan, and it turned out looking like a loaf of bread — a frittata in disguise.
In a heated pan, sauté olive oil, onion, and spinach.
Beat 3 eggs with a little milk, salt, and pepper, mix, and pour into the pan. Tear in cherry tomatoes and burrata cheese.
Once it looks roughly cooked, cover with a plate and (heave-ho) flip it over. Drizzle olive oil in the pan and cook the other side.
Flip it back onto a plate.
A #frittata really only tastes right when it's cooked this thoroughly.

끓는 물에 소금 조금, 펜네를 삶는다. 익으면 건져내고 그릇에 담은 뒤 서로 엉겨 붙지 않도록 올리브오일을 두른다. 
마늘을 썰어 올리브오일 두른 팬에 볶는다. (맛을 좀 더 풍요롭게 해줄 양파 등을 넣으면 좋겠지만, 요새 시판 토마토소스 맛이 훌륭하니 생략한다.) 시판 토마토소스를 붓고 삶아 놓은 펜네를 넣고 볶는다. 그린그린한 것이 보이면 좋을 것 같아서 시금치도 조금 넣는다. 
접시에 담고 세상에서 제일 예쁜 부라타치즈를 올린다. 마무리 후추는 국룰이다. 
토마토 넣는 것을 깜빡했다.

_en.title: Tomato Pasta
_en.intro:
20230924 #breakfastdiary 854, 20°C/mostly clear, 38min/exercise(Y, T)
Boil penne in salted water. Once cooked, drain and toss with olive oil in a bowl so it doesn't stick together.
Slice garlic and sauté it in an olive-oiled pan. (Onion would make the flavor richer, but store-bought tomato sauce is so good these days that I skip it.) Pour in the store-bought tomato sauce, add the boiled penne, and stir-fry. Thinking a bit of green would be nice, I toss in some spinach too.
Plate it and top with the prettiest burrata cheese in the world. A finishing dash of pepper is the golden rule.
I forgot to add the tomato.

title: 간장드레싱카펠리니 카페리니
intro:
20230922, #조식다이어리 852, 15도/대체로흐림
문제는 말글살이라는 게 복잡하고 섬세한 사람살이의 영향권 아래에 있다는 점이다. 행위 주체를 명확히 밝히는 일이 무례해 보일 수도 있고 괜한 낭패를 당할 수도 있다. 행위 주체를 모를 경우도 있다. 독자에게 익숙한 정보가 주체보다는 대상인 경우도 있고, 당하는 대상에 초점을 맞추고 싶을 때도 있다. ‘해양생태계가 파괴되었다’고 하는 게 ‘일본 정부가 해양생태계를 파괴했다’보다 더 슬플 수 있다.
(김진해, 피동형을 즐겨라) 
이오덕 선생의 책을 읽으며, 학보사 선배로부터, 늘 문장은 가능한 한 능동태로 써야한다고 배웠건만, 피동형이 힘을 가지는 문장도 있구나라고 생각하며 오늘의 레시피를 피동형으로 적어보려 했으나 실패, 
끓는 물에 카펠리니를 삶는다. 면발이 얇아서 금새 익는다. 
간장3, 쯔유1, 올리고당1, 설탕1, 참기름1, 다진마늘1/2, 참깨를 섞어 드레싱 만든다. 
카펠리니를 접시에 담고 다진 실파 듬뿍, 드레싱과 계란노른자를 올린다.

이오덕 선생의 책을 읽으며, 학보사 선배로부터, 늘 문장은 가능한 한 능동태로 써야한다고 배웠건만, 피동형이 힘을 가지는 문장도 있구나라고 생각하며 오늘의 레시피를 피동형으로 적어보려 했으나 실패, 

#간장드레싱카펠리니

끓는 물에 카펠리니를 삶는다. 면발이 얇아서 금새 익는다. 
간장3, 쯔유1, 올리고당1, 설탕1, 참기름1, 다진마늘1/2, 참깨를 섞어 드레싱 만든다. 
카펠리니를 접시에 담고 다진 실파 듬뿍, 드레싱과 계란노른자를 올린다. 

#조식 #레시피 #미라클모닝 #카페리니

_en.title: Soy Dressing Capellini
_en.intro:
20230922 #breakfastdiary 852, 15°C/mostly cloudy
The trouble is that language and writing live under the influence of complicated, delicate human relationships. Naming the subject of an action too clearly can seem rude, or land you in trouble for no good reason. Sometimes you simply don't know who the subject is. Sometimes the object is more familiar to the reader than the subject, or you want the focus to fall on whoever is affected. Saying 'the marine ecosystem was destroyed' can feel sadder than 'the Japanese government destroyed the marine ecosystem.'
(Kim Jin-hae, Embrace the Passive Voice)
Reading Lee O-deok's books, and having learned from a senior at the campus newspaper that sentences should always be written in the active voice as much as possible, I thought, well, there are sentences where the passive voice carries real force — and tried to write today's recipe in the passive voice. I failed.
Boil capellini in bubbling water. The strands are thin, so they cook in no time.
Mix soy sauce 3, tsuyu 1, oligosaccharide syrup 1, sugar 1, sesame oil 1, minced garlic 1/2, and sesame seeds to make the dressing.
Plate the capellini, top generously with chopped scallions, the dressing, and an egg yolk.

intro:

이것의 이름은 병아리콩시금치양파토마토샐러드(가나다 순) 
1. 어젯 밤 잠들기 전에 불린 병아리콩을 끓는 물에 삶는다. (잘 익었나 맛보니, 맛있구나,) 
2. 달군 팬에 올리브오일, 양파 데치다가 방울토마토, 시금치, 병아리콩 순으로 넣고 함께 데친다. (양파는 오래 데치면 물러지니 따로 데치고 나중에 합.체.하는 것도 좋겠다. 방울토마토에 칼집을 내면 조리시간을 줄일 수 있다. 드레싱이 기다리고 있으므로 소금간은 하지 않고 후추 정도) 
3. 올리브오일3, 와인비니거1, 홀그레인 머스타드 기분대로(보통 1/4정도 넣는다.) 섞어서 드레싱 올리고, #국룰 후추로 마무리한다.

_en.title: Classic Chickpea Salad
_en.intro:
20230920 #breakfastdiary 850, 21°C/rainy, 21min/exercise(U)
The name of this dish is Chickpea-Spinach-Onion-Tomato Salad (in alphabetical order).
1. Boil chickpeas that were soaked overnight before bed. (Tasted one to check — yep, delicious.)
2. In a heated pan with olive oil, blanch the onion, then add cherry tomatoes, spinach, and chickpeas in that order and blanch together. (Onion turns mushy if blanched too long, so it might be better to blanch it separately and com·bine them later. Scoring the cherry tomatoes cuts down the cooking time. Since the dressing is waiting in the wings, skip the salt here and just add a little pepper.)
3. Mix olive oil 3, wine vinegar 1, and whole-grain mustard to taste (usually about 1/4) for the dressing, drizzle it on, and finish with pepper, the #goldenrule.

title: 감자 비건
intro:
20230918, #조식다이어리 848, 22도/대체로흐림, 21분/운동(Y)
히딩크와 퍼거슨은 불같이 화를 내기도 하는데, 그렇게 가끔은 선수의 감정을 상하게 하는 것 조차 전략이라는 거야. 감독은 일부러 화낼 줄도 알고 따뜻하게 품을 줄도 알아야 하는데, 본인은 따뜻한 건 가능해도 화내는 결 못하겠더래. 그래서 자신의 길이 감독은 아니라고 확신했대. 
(홍성태, 브랜드로 남는다는 것)
본인은 누구일까요? 
냄비에 물을 붓고 소금 조금 넣고 깍둑썰기한 감자를 삶는다. 팬에 올리브오일 두르고 양파를 볶다가 투명해지면 삶은 감자와 템페를 넣고 볶는다.
코코넛밀크 1/2컵, 시금치를 넣고 데친다. 소금 약간 넣어 간을 한다.

_en.title: Ricotta Sun-Dried Tomato Toast
_en.intro:
20230911 #breakfastdiary 842, 22°C/mostly cloudy, 21min/exercise(Y)
Giving up your own preference to pursue variety looks, at a glance, like an 'irrational decision.' But it's human nature. For instance, if you're buying just one yogurt, most people will pick plain or strawberry.
But what if you're buying a week's worth of yogurt? Then you'll grab flavors you'd never normally pick, like blueberry. When there are lots of options on the table, we end up making irrational decisions.
Source: @longblack.co, Energy Drink Report: Reading the Next Beverage Trend, a 95-Trillion-Won Market
If you want a rational decision, about two options is ideal.
Brush bread with olive oil and toast both sides until crisp. Spread on plenty of ricotta cheese and top with chopped sun-dried tomatoes. Olive oil, and pepper, pepper.

_en.intro:
20230910 #breakfastdiary 841, 25°C/cloudy, 21min/exercise(Y)

title: 마이야르 토스트 완두콩토스트
intro:
20230906, #조식다이어리 838, 23도/대체로맑음, 21분/운동(C) 
팬에 물을 조금 붓고 완두콩을 넣고 2~3분 익힌다. 저수분 조리법이다. 익었나, 하나 집어 먹어ㅜ봤는데 냉동한 완두콩 주제에 달다. 건져서 채에 받혀둔다. 
올리브 빵에 올리브오일 바르고 #마이야르 반응을 기대하며 앞뒤로 바삭하게 굽는다. 구운 빵은 접시에 담고 아직 열기가 남아있는 팬에 올리브오일 조금 넣고 익힌 완두콩을 데친다. 약간 짭쪼름한 것도 괜찮을 것 같아서 소금, 잡내를 잡아줄, 테크니컬리 안 넣으면 섭섭할 것 같은 후추도 조금 넣는다. 
빵을 집어들고 리코타치즈를 바른다. 리코타치즈는 발림성이 좋은 편이다. (발림성 면에서 크림치즈는 빌런이다.) 팬에 데친 완두콩을 소복하게 올리고 파마산 치즈도 올린다. 마지막으로 안 넣으면 섭섭한 후추도 살짝 곁들인다.

_en.title: Maillard Toast with Peas
_en.intro:
20230906 #breakfastdiary 838, 23°C/mostly clear, 21min/exercise(C)
Pour a little water into a pan, add green peas, and cook for 2-3 minutes. It's a low-moisture cooking method. Testing if they're done, I ate one — sweet, for frozen peas. Drain and set aside in a strainer.
Brush olive bread with olive oil and toast both sides until crisp, hoping for that #maillard reaction. Plate the toasted bread, then with the pan still warm, add a little olive oil and blanch the cooked peas. Thinking a touch of saltiness would be nice, I add some salt, and — technically it'd feel wrong to skip it — a bit of pepper to cut any off-flavor.
Pick up the bread and spread on ricotta cheese. Ricotta has good spreadability. (In terms of spreadability, cream cheese is the villain.) Pile the blanched peas generously on top and add parmesan cheese. Finish with a light dash of pepper — it'd feel wrong to skip that too.

_en.title: Peach Salad
_en.intro:
20230901 #breakfastdiary 833, 19°C/mostly clear
This peach, somehow, spent enough time in the fridge that a firm peach edged close to becoming a soft, juicy one. Fresh flavor and good looks were no longer really on the table.
Meanwhile, kaymak — which has been popping up everywhere lately — has a texture a bit like clotted cream. And just as clotted cream pairs best with jam, kaymak, it turns out, wants honey.
So today's breakfast is a #peachsalad finished as a three-way combo: a peach that's lost its freshness but gained ripe sweetness, kaymak, and honey.

_en.title: Salmon Ochazuke
_en.intro:
20230829 #breakfastdiary 831, 21°C/cloudy
This salmon can't decide whether it's about to spoil — so let's just grill it. Heat olive oil in a pan, sprinkle the salmon generously with pepper, and sear it crisp on all sides — front, back, top, bottom.
Mix 500ml of water with green tea powder that dissolves well even in cold water, and stir in about a spoonful of fish sauce. This condenses all the time and effort you'd normally spend on kelp, bonito flakes, and so on, into a curious flavor that's quick but not exactly deep.
Spoon rice into a bowl, sprinkle a little furikake, add the grilled salmon on top, and pour over the green tea.
It brings back memories of childhood and my grandmother — mixing rice into strong barley tea that sometimes still had a bit of roasted barley grain to chew on — so in a way, it's soul food.

_en.title: Potatoes
_en.intro:
20230825, #breakfastdiary 827, 23°C/mostly cloudy
Boiled potatoes turn dry and mealy after just half a day. No, actually "dry and mealy" doesn't quite capture it — there really should be a special word for that particular sad staleness a potato develops once it's been sitting around after boiling. The kind where you pull one out of the fridge, take a bite, and mutter to yourself, self-deprecatingly, "yep, gone full sad-potato." 
Anyway, so today's mission was a flavor-rescue project for my sad, stale potatoes. First I cut them into wedges, then blanch them in a pan with olive oil. Sauté. Roast. Then season generously with salt, pepper, and — better than any dried herb — fresh rosemary, for a really deep aroma. (sniff sniff sniff) Oh, and don't forget the green olives — they're like the little star-shaped candies hidden in a pack of hardtack biscuits.

당근 한 개 채치고 올리브오일 3, 와인비니거 1, 홀그레인 머스타드 1/2 넣어 골고루 섞는다. 후추후추, 그린올리브 넣어 으깨고 함께 섞는다. 파슬리 대신 올리브를 넣으니 색감도 살고 간도 적절하다.

_en.title: Carrot Rapée with Croutons
_en.intro:
20230824, #breakfastdiary 826, 23°C/drizzle
Julienne one carrot and toss it well with 3 parts olive oil, 1 part wine vinegar, and 1/2 part wholegrain mustard. Pepper, pepper, then crush in some green olives and mix through. Using olives instead of parsley keeps the color nice and seasons it just right. 
(But I need some carbs.) There are some old crusts in the fridge, leftover from making sandwiches. I cut them into bite-sized pieces and sauté them in a pan with olive oil, minced garlic, and herbs to make croutons. Right — you really do need carbs if you want to get moving.

title: 에어룸 토마토 샐러드
intro:
20230817, #조식다이어리 820, 24도/대체로흐림
스테비아 토마토, 설탕보다 200~300배 단 스테비아를 밭이나 토마토에 직접 주입해서 만들어 채소가 아닌 가공식품으로 분류된다고. 
에어룸 토마토 Heirloom Tomato 는 스테비아 토마토처럼 인위적인 유전자 조작을 거치지 않은 원형 그대로의 순종 토마토를 일컫는다. 단맛도 덜하고 껍질도 얇지만 토마토 본연의 맛을 느낄 수 있다.
ingredients: 에어룸 토마토, 부라타치즈 1개, 비네그레트 드레싱(올리브오일 3T, 화이트와인 비니거 1T, 홀그레인 머스타드 1t)
steps:
1. 에어룸 토마토를 깨끗하게 씻어 가로로 자르고 접시에 놓는다. 
2. 그 위에 부라타치즈 얹고 비네그레트 드레싱 뿌린다

title: 한끼일기챌린지 깻잎과김자반을곁들인들기름카펠리니 들기름
intro:
20230816, #조식다이어리 819, 24도/대체로맑음
-
그러니까 2020년 7월 13일 시작된 나조식씨의 세계(관)에서는 매일 아침 새로운 조식이 등장(해야)한다. 조식을 해먹을 수 없는 피치 못할 사유가 있는 날, 가령 1년에 한 번 정도 있는 건강 검진하는 날의 아침 (금식)이라든가, 출장이나 여행처럼 특별한 날은 예외로 하고, 거의 매일 아침 새로운 조식이 등장(해야)하는 것이다. 
-
"글쎄요, 음, 이건 저만의, 하루를 시작하는 리추얼인거죠. 하루 중 유일하게 내 마음대로 할 수 있는 시간, 그로부터 마음의 안정을 추구하는, 뭐 그런 거?" 언젠가 부캐 나조식을 아는 누군가가 도대체, 어떻게, 그렇게, 매일 다른 아침을 해먹을 수 있냐는 질문에 이렇게 대답했다. 아주, 썩, 꽤, 무척 있어빌리티한 답변이라고 자평했다. 
-
하지만 사실 그 답변은 어느 정도는 진심이며 동시에 사실이다. (대부분) 전날 저녁, 다음 날 아침 메뉴를 떠올리고 준비하는 시간, 아침에 일어나 재료를 준비하고 조리하는 시간, 준비된 조식을 기록하는 시간 그리고 (이 가운데 가장 짧은) 먹는 시간까지, 이 모든 시간들은 시각, 청각, 후각, 미각, 촉각적 경험의 결합체이며 더 나아가 공감각 경험으로 승화되는 숭고한 시간인 것이다. 그러므로 하루를 시작하는 (심지어) 거룩한 리추얼이라 불러도 손색이 없지 않겠는가? 
-
그래서 이토록 장황했던 #한끼일기챌린지 의 주인공이자, 한끼, 오늘의 조식은 #깻잎과김자반을곁들인들기름카펠리니 다. '천사의 머리카락'이라는 별칭을 가진 카펠리니에 맛소금, 설탕을 넣어 기름에 튀긴, 이른바 '한국의 후리가케', 김자반 그리고 뭔가 오야꼬동(부모자식덮밥)을 연상시키는 깻잎과 그 씨앗을 짜낸 들기름의 조합은 마치 지단, 라울, 베컴, 피구가 뛰었던 우주방위군 시절 레알을 연상시키지 않는가? 그렇다면 지금 당장 부엌을 뒤져 깻잎과 김자반, 카펠리니가 있는지 확인하고 전통기름의 새로운 문화를 만드는 로컬 방앗간 @okhee_mill 옥희방앗간 라이트로스팅 들기름을 주문할 것!
1. 팬에 물 붓고 물이 끓으면 카펠리니를 한 줌, 익으면 건져내서 찬물에 헹군다. 
2. 연두2, 물2, 설탕1 넣어 드레싱을 만든다. 
3. 접시에 카펠리니를 담고, 김자반과 다진 깻잎을 담는다. (들깨가루를 넣는다면 맛이 두 배로 폭발,) 
4. 2의 드레싱과 옥희방앗간 들기름을 우아하게 두른다.

_en.title: Perilla Oil Capellini with Perilla Leaves and Gim-jaban
_en.intro:
20230816, #breakfastdiary 819, 24°C/mostly clear
-
So, in the world according to Ms. Breakfast — a persona born on July 13, 2020 — a brand new breakfast must appear every single morning. Except, of course, on days when cooking breakfast simply isn't possible: the one morning a year of a health checkup (fasting required), or special occasions like business trips or travel. Otherwise, nearly every morning, a new breakfast has to show up. 
-
"Well, um, this is just my own personal ritual for starting the day. The one stretch of the day that's entirely mine to spend as I please, a way of chasing a little peace of mind, I guess?" Someone who once found out about my alter ego, Ms. Breakfast, asked how on earth I managed to cook something different every single morning, and that's how I answered. I privately rated my own response as pretty, quite, remarkably impressive-sounding. 
-
But honestly, that answer is, to some degree, both sincere and true. From the time the night before spent imagining and prepping the next morning's menu, to waking up and getting the ingredients ready and cooking, to recording the finished breakfast, and finally — the shortest part of all — actually eating it: every one of these moments is a fusion of sight, sound, smell, taste, and touch, elevated into something like a synesthetic experience. So wouldn't it be fair to call it a sacred ritual for starting the day? 
-
And so, the star of this long-winded #onemealdiarychallenge, today's one and only breakfast, is #perillaoilcapelliniwithperillaleavesandgimjaban. Capellini — nicknamed "angel hair" — deep-fried with seasoned salt and sugar to become a kind of "Korean furikake," combined with gim-jaban (seasoned seaweed flakes) and perilla leaves that somehow evoke oyakodon (the parent-and-child rice bowl), all tied together with perilla oil pressed from the very seeds of those leaves — doesn't that lineup rival Real Madrid's Galácticos era, with Zidane, Raúl, Beckham, and Figo all on the pitch together? If that sounds tempting, go check your kitchen right now for perilla leaves, gim-jaban, and capellini, and order some light-roasted perilla oil from @okhee_mill, the local mill reviving traditional oil culture!
1. Pour water into a pan, and once it boils, add a handful of capellini; when cooked, drain and rinse in cold water. 
2. Make a dressing with 2 parts Yondu, 2 parts water, and 1 part sugar. 
3. Plate the capellini, then add gim-jaban and chopped perilla leaves. (Adding ground perilla seed powder doubles the flavor explosion.) 
4. Elegantly drizzle over the dressing from step 2 and the perilla oil from Okhee Mill.

_en.title: Asparagus with Prosciutto
_en.intro:
20230806, #breakfastdiary 809, 31°C/mostly cloudy
Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning 
Curious what "dead reckoning" actually meant, I looked it up: #deadreckoning is the practice of navigating using only the information you already have, once your signal has cut out. 
Take a car navigation system, for example — when a tunnel blocks the GPS signal and the algorithm keeps estimating your position anyway, that counts as dead reckoning too. These days, the gyro sensor in your smartphone supplies the data for it. 
It's never a good thing when everyday "dead reckoning" drags on too long. None of us are Ethan Hunt, after all. 
1. Trim the asparagus with a mandoline, then pan-sear with olive oil, salt, and pepper. 
2. Plate the asparagus, top with prosciutto and a soft-boiled egg, and finish with Parmesan and olive oil.

_en.intro:
20230728, #breakfastdiary 800, 26°C/mostly clear
"In the face of nature's vastness, everyday problems shrink down to size. More than anything, walking through nature is where we finally get to experience something close to a source, a wellspring. All five senses feel satisfied, and the heart feels full. Because we humans are, after all, part of nature."
(Albert Kitzler, the philosopher who writes about walking: "Learn Endurance by Walking," Longblack @longblack.co) 
For some people it's walking, for others it's drinks with friends, and for others still, it's breakfast — any of these can be that experience of touching something close to a source. 
(Since there's no actual crab🦀 in store-bought poo pad pong curry paste,) here's crab-stick poo pad pong curry — imitation crab meat coated in starch and fried crisp to mimic soft-shell crab. 
1. (Any brand works🙅) Tear the crab sticks into thick strips and coat evenly with starch. 
2. Heat oil in a pan and fry the starch-coated crab sticks until crisp. 
3. Add 100ml water and 1 beaten egg to store-bought crab poo pad pong curry sauce. 
4. Place the crab sticks from step 2 over rice and pour the curry from step 3 on top. Finish with green onion, 
#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning here's #crabstickpoopadpongcurry

_en.title: Mackerel Ochazuke
_en.intro:
20230726, #breakfastdiary 798, 25°C/mostly cloudy (the sun kept popping out and disappearing all morning) 
When I was little, my grandmother would sometimes soak my rice in chilled barley tea. This isn't quite as cool and refreshing as that was, but, 
1. Bring 500ml of water to a boil with a piece of kelp, then remove the kelp once it boils. 
2. Add bonito flakes to steep the broth, strain them out, then stir in 1 part tsuyu, 1 part mirim, and matcha. (A green tea bag works fine in place of matcha too👌) 
3. Pour the broth from step 2 over a bowl of rice, add a sprinkle of furikake, and top with grilled mackerel.

_en.title: Avocado Natto Egg Bowl
_en.intro:
20230724 #breakfastdiary 796, 24°C/cloudy
There used to be a weird rumor that the chalaza (the little white string attached to the egg yolk) is loaded with cholesterol — but that's just a rumor. Most of the cholesterol in an egg is concentrated in the yolk, and the chalaza is really just protein.
1. Take out an avocado that's been ripening wrapped in newspaper, cut it in half, and slice it neatly.
2. Gently top a bowl of rice with avocado, natto, and egg yolk. (Since the rice isn't seasoned) I recommend pouring on about 2T of tsuyu and breaking the yolk to eat it bit by bit.

_en.title: Fusilli Pasta
_en.intro:
20230721 #breakfastdiary 793, 24°C/occasionally cloudy
Like the way the internet has drifted from book-like early web pages and blogs toward listicles, videos, and short-form clips, it looks as though people are increasingly drawn to shorter stories — but really, humans have always preferred short, simple stories, and those are the ones that tend to do relatively well.
So here's today's breakfast: a truly short and simple #fusillipasta recipe — fingers crossed it does well too 🙏🏻
1. Boil fusilli in salted water for about 10 minutes. (Since there's no other seasoning, the amount of salt here decides the flavor.)
2. In a bowl, add basil, tomato, camembert cheese, and half a clove of minced garlic.
3. Pour in the cooked fusilli along with some pasta water. Add plenty of pepper, mix well, and enjoy.

title: 햇감자 포카칩
intro:

감자는 4대 식량작물이다. 1년에 네 번 수확한다. 3~5월은 하우스봄감자, 6~7월은 노지봄감자, 8~11월은 고랭지 감자가 생산된다. 10월부터 이듬해 1월까지는 가을감자가 시장에 나온다. 노지봄감자와 고랭지 감자는 연중 전체 생산량의 70%를 차지한다. 공급량이 많으니 연중 가격은 가장 싸고, 맛은 가장 좋다.
(포카칩에도 제철이? 6월에 감자칩이 더 맛있는 이유)
무심히 지나치기 쉬운데 이 맘때 유통되는 포카칩에는 100% 국산 햇감자라는 레이블이 인쇄되어 있다. (평소엔 햇감자 대신 생감자) 연중 이 맘때만 맛볼 수 있는 제철 음식이다. 
1. 제철 햇감자로 만든 포카칩을 뜯는다. 
2. 며칠 전 만든 차지키 소스에 찍어 먹는다.

_en.title: New Potato Chips with Tzatziki
_en.intro:
20230720 #breakfastdiary 792, 24°C/mostly cloudy
Potatoes are one of Korea's four major staple crops, harvested four times a year. Greenhouse spring potatoes come in March–May, field-grown spring potatoes in June–July, and highland potatoes from August to November. Fall potatoes hit the market from October through the following January. Field-grown spring potatoes and highland potatoes together make up 70% of the year's total production, so when supply is highest, prices are lowest — and the flavor is at its best too.
(Even potato chips have a season? Why chips taste better in June)
It's easy to miss, but the bags of Poca Chips sold around this time of year are labeled "100% Korean new potatoes." (The rest of the year, they use regular potatoes instead.) It's a seasonal food you can only really taste around now.
1. Open a bag of Poca Chips made from seasonal new potatoes.
2. Dip them in the tzatziki I made a few days ago.

title: 옥수수쏨땀 카리스마
intro:
20230719, #조식다이어리 791, 24도/대체로맑음, 21분/운동(C) 
카리스마를 행동 방식으로만 인식하기 때문에, 정치인들은 카리스마를 연출하고 카리스마를 가진 것처럼 연기한다. 현대 민주주의의 시민들은 카리스마적 리더십을 거부하거나 의심한다. 하지만 종종 ‘가짜 카리스마’에 속기도 하고 열광하기까지 한다.
(김용섭, 카리스마: 중요한 건 스타일 아닌 ‘과업의 내용)
소위 카리스마라는 단어를 들었을 때 떠올릴 수 있는 소신, 의지, 추진력은 일을 위한 수단이지 내용이 아니라면, 카리스마 있는 옥수수쏨땀 같은 것도 있을 법 하지 않나?
1. 다진마늘1/2, 액젓1, 라임주스1 섞어 드레싱을 만든다. (조식이므로 매운 고추는 생략,)
2. 토마토를 적당히 썰고 1의 드레싱을 붓는다. 
3. 데친 그린빈, 채썬 당근, 옥수수를 넣고 섞는다. 땅콩 대신 크리스피한 식감을 위해 튀긴 샬롯도 넣는다.

_en.title: Corn Som Tam
_en.intro:
20230719 #breakfastdiary 791, 24°C/mostly clear, 21min/workout(C)
"Because charisma is understood only as a way of behaving, politicians stage it and act as though they have it. Citizens of modern democracies reject or grow suspicious of charismatic leadership — yet they're still often fooled by, and even get swept up in, 'fake charisma.'"
(Kim Yong-seop, Charisma: What Matters Isn't Style but the Substance of the Task)
If the conviction, will, and drive that come to mind when you hear the word 'charisma' are just means to an end rather than the substance itself, then couldn't there be such a thing as a charismatic corn som tam?
1. Mix 1/2T minced garlic, 1T fish sauce, and 1T lime juice to make the dressing. (Skipping the chili since it's breakfast.)
2. Cut tomato into bite-size pieces and pour over the dressing from step 1.
3. Add blanched green beans, julienned carrot, and corn, and toss together. Instead of peanuts, add some fried shallots for crunch.

_en.title: Rye Crackers with Tzatziki
_en.intro:
20230717 #breakfastdiary 789, 23°C/cloudy
It's raining, and even as it rains,
one who is already wet does not get wet again.
(Oh Kyu-won, Even in the Rain, One Who Is Wet)
1. Julienne 1 cucumber, sprinkle with salt, let sit briefly, then squeeze firmly to remove the moisture.
2. Mix the drained cucumber with 5T Greek yogurt and 5 cloves of minced garlic.
3. (No dill on hand, so) add 1T herbs, 1T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, plenty of salt and pepper to make the tzatziki sauce.
4. Spoon the tzatziki onto rye crackers, and (since it looked a little bare) finish with pink peppercorns.

_en.title: Tomato Basil Toast
_en.intro:
20230716 #breakfastdiary 788, 24°C/drizzle
Peace of mind is a luxury — sometimes even an ordinary steady mind feels out of reach. Chopping tomatoes and basil, I find myself thinking about staying even-keeled.
1. Put bread in a hot pan, brush with olive oil, and toast both sides.
2. Chop 3 tomatoes and a good amount of basil, mix in 3T mayonnaise. (It's best to scoop out the tomato seeds first.)
3. Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise on the toast and top with the mixture from step 2. Add a little extra salt to taste if you like.

_en.title: Tomato Egg Stir-Fry
_en.intro:
20230713 #breakfastdiary 785, 24°C/drizzle, 21min/workout(L)
Written as #tomatoeggstirfry, read as #tomatoscramble.
1. Sauté oil and scallion in a pan. Right about the moment you think, 'uh oh, is this burning?' — add the tomato.
2. Beat 3 eggs with 5T milk and a pinch of salt, and set aside.
3. Push the tomato to one side of the pan, pour in the egg mixture, and stir-fry. Once the egg is just about set, mix it together with the tomato.
*For a better egg texture, I'd recommend scrambling the egg first, setting it aside, then stir-frying the tomato and adding the egg back in afterward.

_en.title: Lemon Pasta
_en.intro:
20230711 #breakfastdiary 783, 24°C/cloudy, 21min/workout(U)
A refreshing #lemonpasta that says summer has arrived
1. Boil capellini in salted water. (This is the first and only seasoning, so make it good and salty.)
2. Sauté butter and minced garlic in a pan. (Sliced garlic would be even better, but I didn't have any.)
3. Add the capellini to the pan with a ladle of pasta water and a knob of butter. Time to mantecare.
4. Plate it up with an egg yolk, parmesan cheese, and half a lemon — zested and squeezed for juice.

title: 토마토
intro:
20230710, #조식다이어리 782, 22도/흐림, 21분/운동(Y) 
조식을 매일 만들다 보면 소량의 푸른잎 채소가 필요한데 파슬리, 깻잎, (민트 가운데서도) 스피어 민트는 다른 채소에 비해 오래가서 아주 유용하다. 
이번 주 내내 비가 온다니, 몸과 마음의 대비가 필요할 것 같다.

2. 큰 토마토를 썰어 바닥에 깔고, 작은 토마토는 (4등분 하니 조금 커서,) 6등분 해서 위에 올린다. 파슬리를 다져서 올린다. 
3. 비네그레트 드레싱을 골고루 뿌린다. 
#조식 #레시피 #미라클모닝 #토마토, 파슬리
